### bin/rad/cluster.js
```
// SH codebook clustering adapted from MIT-licensed code. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { availableParallelism } from "node:os";
import { isMainThread, parentPort, workerData } from "node:worker_threads";
import { HALF } from "./math.js";
import { WorkerGroup, clusterers } from "./parallel.js";
import { Progress } from "./progress.js";
import { SH_DIMS } from "./splats.js";
import { PagedArray } from "./storage.js";

// Codebook entries at most: RAD labels are 16-bit.
const MAX_CODES = 65536;
// Training reads SAMPLE_SHARE of the splats, and at least SAMPLES_PER_CODE
// per entry; larger models train on a sample by weight, and only the final
// assignment reads all. Entries start at evenly spaced training splats.
// With codebooks shrunk to keep 16 per entry at 5%, renders of Elevator and
// JunkShop came 5–14% closer to the uncompressed SH at 10% than at 5%; on
// C-NorthSouth (111M splats after LOD) clustering took about 185 s, not 170.
// On Elevator (3.9M splats after LOD), 64 per entry, here all splats, came
// 5.8% closer than 16 at full detail, with 41% fewer pixels off by more than
// 32 levels in LOD views, in 18 s instead of 6 s.
const SAMPLES_PER_CODE = 64;
const SAMPLE_SHARE = 0.1;
// Splats per job of a thread, and per call of the kernel.
const JOB = 4096;
const BATCH = 1024;
// Jobs per thread that are read and not yet consumed, at most; a thread
// computes one at a time.
const WINDOW = 3;
// Codes per block of the kernel's layout.
const BLOCK = 8;
// With at least GROUPS × 32 entries, each pass searches only part of them:
// the entries are clustered into GROUPS groups, and each splat searches the
// entries of the groups with the nearest centers, TRAIN_PROBES of them in
// iterations and FINAL_PROBES in the final pass. Grouping takes GROUP_STEPS
// steps from evenly spaced entries, then one from the last pass's groups.
// On Elevator this fit the entries better than comparing all of them, as
// with few probes entries stay near their groups, in a twentieth of the
// time; the final pass gave 99% of splats their nearest entry.
const GROUPS = 512;
const TRAIN_PROBES = 2;
const FINAL_PROBES = 24;
const GROUP_STEPS = 4;

let kernel;
// The compiled nearest-code kernel, loaded before converting.
export function codebookKernel() {
  if (kernel) return kernel;
  let bytes;
  try {
    bytes = readFileSync(new URL("../decoder/cluster.wasm", import.meta.url));
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code !== "ENOENT") throw error;
    throw new Error(
      "SH clustering module not found; build it with npm run build:wasm:lod",
    );
  }
  kernel = new WebAssembly.Module(bytes);
  return kernel;
}

// Bytes of a kernel instance's memory for `blocks` blocks of codes, with the
// module's own 1 MiB, and for the groups of the final assignment, if any:
// each group may add a block, and `scratch` bytes for the search.
function kernelBytes(dims, blocks, groups, scratch) {
  return (
    ((blocks + groups) * BLOCK + groups) * (dims + 1) * 4 +
    groups * 8 +
    scratch +
    BATCH * (dims * 4 + 64 + 6) +
    1024 ** 2
  );
}

// A thread's instance of the kernel, with the codes in blocks of 8, their
// squared lengths, and room for a batch of points, the kernel's state and
// the labels; with `groups`, also room for the grouped codes, the groups'
// centers and table, and the search's scratch memory.
class Nearest {
  constructor(module, dims, blocks, groups) {
    const { exports } = new WebAssembly.Instance(module, {});
    const memory = exports.memory;
    const align = (bytes) => Math.ceil(bytes / 16) * 16;
    const slots = (blocks + groups) * BLOCK;
    const centers = Math.ceil(groups / BLOCK) * BLOCK;
    this.exports = exports;
    this.dims = dims;
    this.blocks = blocks;
    this.groups = 0;
    this.codes = align(memory.buffer.byteLength);
    this.norms = this.codes + slots * dims * 4;
    this.centers = align(this.norms + slots * 4);
    this.centerNorms = this.centers + centers * dims * 4;
    this.starts = align(this.centerNorms + centers * 4);
    this.sizes = this.starts + groups * 4;
    this.points = align(this.sizes + groups * 4);
    this.state = align(this.points + BATCH * dims * 4);
    this.labels = this.state + (BATCH / 4) * 256;
    this.slots = align(this.labels + BATCH * 2);
    this.scratch = this.slots + BATCH * 4;
    const end =
      this.scratch +
      (groups ? exports.probed_scratch(BATCH, dims, groups, FINAL_PROBES) : 0);
    memory.grow(Math.ceil((end - memory.buffer.byteLength) / 65536));
    const { buffer } = memory;
    this.codeView = new Float32Array(buffer, this.codes, slots * dims);
    this.normView = new Float32Array(buffer, this.norms, slots);
    this.centerView = new Float32Array(buffer, this.centers, centers * dims);
    this.centerNormView = new Float32Array(buffer, this.centerNorms, centers);
    this.startView = new Uint32Array(buffer, this.starts, groups);
    this.sizeView = new Uint32Array(buffer, this.sizes, groups);
    this.pointView = new Float32Array(buffer, this.points, BATCH * dims);
    this.labelView = new Uint16Array(buffer, this.labels, BATCH);
    this.slotView = new Uint32Array(buffer, this.slots, BATCH);
    this.center = new Float64Array(dims);
    this.warm = false;
  }

  handle(message) {
    if (message.type === "codes") {
      this.codeView.set(message.codes);
      this.normView.set(message.norms);
      this.center.set(message.center);
      // A first small call makes the engine optimize the kernel before the
      // next: a call that runs long stays unoptimized to its end.
      if (!this.warm) this.call(4);
      this.warm = true;
      return true;
    }
    if (message.type === "groups") {
      // From now on, codes are searched by group; `order` maps their
      // positions to their indices.
      this.codeView.set(message.codes);
      this.normView.set(message.norms);
      this.centerView.set(message.centers);
      this.centerNormView.set(message.centerNorms);
      this.startView.set(message.starts);
      this.sizeView.set(message.sizes);
      this.center.set(message.center);
      this.order = message.order;
      this.probes = message.probes;
      this.groups = message.starts.length;
      this.call(4);
      return true;
    }
    if (message.type === "group") {
      // For grouping, codes are the points: labels `count` of them from
      // `first` with their nearest centers, in shared memory.
      const { points, centers, norms, labels, first, count } = message;
      const { dims, pointView, labelView } = this;
      this.centerView.set(centers);
      this.centerNormView.set(norms);
      for (let start = first; start < first + count; start += BATCH) {
        const size = Math.min(BATCH, first + count - start);
        const rows = Math.ceil(size / 4) * 4;
        pointView.set(points.subarray(start * dims, (start + size) * dims));
        for (let i = size; i < rows; i++)
          pointView.copyWithin(i * dims, (size - 1) * dims, size * dims);
        this.exports.nearest(
          this.points,
          rows,
          dims,
          this.centers,
          this.centerNorms,
          centers.length / (BLOCK * dims),
          this.state,
          this.labels,
        );
        labels.set(labelView.subarray(0, size), start);
      }
      return true;
    }
    const { bits, labels, count } = message;
    const { dims, center, pointView, labelView, slotView, order } = this;
    for (let start = 0; start < count; start += BATCH) {
      const size = Math.min(BATCH, count - start);
      // Points relative to the center; the last fills the final group of 4.
      const rows = Math.ceil(size / 4) * 4;
      for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
        const row = (start + Math.min(i, size - 1)) * dims;
        for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++)
          pointView[i * dims + d] = HALF[bits[row + d]] - center[d];
      }
      this.call(rows);
      if (!this.groups) labels.set(labelView.subarray(0, size), start);
      else
        for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) labels[start + i] = order[slotView[i]];
    }
    return { labels, bits };
  }

  call(rows) {
    if (!this.groups) {
      this.exports.nearest(
        this.points,
        rows,
        this.dims,
        this.codes,
        this.norms,
        this.blocks,
        this.state,
        this.labels,
      );
      return;
    }
    this.exports.probed(
      this.points,
      rows,
      this.dims,
      this.centers,
      this.centerNorms,
      this.groups,
      this.codes,
      this.norms,
      this.starts,
      this.sizes,
      this.probes,
      this.scratch,
      this.slots,
    );
  }
}

if (!isMainThread && workerData?.codebook) {
  const { module, dims, blocks, groups } = workerData;
  const nearest = new Nearest(module, dims, blocks, groups);
  parentPort.on("message", (message) => {
    const result = nearest.handle(message);
    parentPort.postMessage(
      result,
      result === true ? [] : [result.labels.buffer, result.bits.buffer],
    );
  });
}

// Spreads nearest-code jobs over worker threads, or runs them on this thread
// without any.
class Assigner extends WorkerGroup {
  constructor(module, dims, blocks, groups, count) {
    super(
      new URL(import.meta.url),
      count,
      { codebook: true, module, dims, blocks, groups },
      count ? undefined : new Nearest(module, dims, blocks, groups),
      "SH clustering",
    );
  }

  // Gives every thread the codes, or their groups, in a message of `type`;
  // workers copy them from shared memory.
  use(type, layout) {
    return this.broadcast({ type, ...layout });
  }

  // Labels codes with their nearest group centers for grouping, the codes
  // spread evenly over the threads.
  group(work) {
    const { threads } = this;
    const each = Math.ceil(work.count / threads.length);
    return Promise.all(
      threads.map((worker, t) => {
        const first = Math.min(t * each, work.count);
        const count = Math.min(each, work.count - first);
        return this.request(worker, { type: "group", ...work, first, count });
      }),
    );
  }

  // Runs `jobs` jobs, each from `read(index)`, and passes each with its
  // labels to `consume` in job order. The buffers of a job travel to its
  // thread and back. No more than WINDOW jobs per thread are read but not
  // consumed: a slow job holds back the next instead of letting finished
  // ones pile up. A thread has one job at a time, as a job takes far longer
  // than its messages, so a slow thread holds back only that one. After a
  // failure no more start.
  run(jobs, read, consume) {
    const { threads } = this;
    const busy = threads.map(() => false);
    const results = new Map();
    let next = 0;
    let done = 0;
    let stopped = false;
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const stop = (error) => {
        if (!stopped) reject(error);
        stopped = true;
      };
      const pump = () => {
        if (stopped) return;
        try {
          for (; results.has(done); done++) {
            consume(results.get(done));
            results.delete(done);
          }
          if (done === jobs) {
            stopped = true;
            resolve();
            return;
          }
          for (let t = 0; t < threads.length && next < jobs; t++) {
            if (busy[t]) continue;
            if (next - done >= WINDOW * threads.length) break;
            const job = read(next++);
            const { bits, labels, count } = job;
            busy[t] = true;
            this.request(threads[t], { bits, labels, count }, [
              bits.buffer,
              labels.buffer,
            ]).then((result) => {
              busy[t] = false;
              job.bits = result.bits;
              job.labels = result.labels;
              results.set(job.index, job);
              pump();
            }, stop);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          stop(error);
        }
      };
      pump();
    });
  }
}

// Reads splats' SH as rows of half bits, the bands one after another, with
// their weights, area × opacity as merging weighs them.
class Rows {
  constructor(splats, dims) {
    this.splats = splats;
    this.dims = dims;
    this.length = splats.length;
    this.column = new Uint16Array(JOB * SH_DIMS[SH_DIMS.length - 1]);
    this.records = new Float32Array(JOB * 16);
  }

  read(base, count, bits, weights) {
    const { splats, dims, column } = this;
    let offset = 0;
    for (let band = 0; band < splats.maxSh; band++) {
      const size = SH_DIMS[band];
      splats.sh[band].read(base * size, column, count * size);
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++)
        for (let d = 0; d < size; d++)
          bits[i * dims + offset + d] = column[i * size + d];
      offset += size;
    }
    this.weigh(base, count, weights);
  }

  weigh(base, count, weights) {
    const records = this.splats.records.read(
      base * 16,
      this.records,
      count * 16,
    );
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++)
      weights[i] = records[i * 16 + 15] * records[i * 16 + 3];
  }
}

// Rows and weights sampled from other rows.
class Sample {
  constructor(workspace, dims) {
    this.dims = dims;
    this.length = 0;
    this.bits = new PagedArray(workspace, Uint16Array);
    this.weights = new PagedArray(workspace, Float64Array);
  }

  read(base, count, bits, weights) {
    this.bits.read(base * this.dims, bits, count * this.dims);
    this.weights.read(base, weights, count);
  }

  dispose() {
    this.bits.dispose();
    this.weights.dispose();
  }
}

// The histogram bucket of a weight: its top 16 bits in single precision,
// which order nonnegative values.
const float = new Float32Array(1);
const word = new Uint32Array(float.buffer);
function bucket(weight) {
  float[0] = weight;
  return word[0] >>> 16;
}

// Samples about `size` rows, each with probability min(1, weight / step):
// rows weighing at least the step stay with their weights, and the others
// are taken where the running total of their weights crosses each multiple
// of the step, weighing one step. The weighted means of the sample then
// estimate those of all rows, also when a few rows hold most of the weight,
// as coarse LOD splats do. The step that makes about `size` rows follows
// from a histogram of the weights.
function sample(rows, size, workspace) {
  const { dims, length } = rows;
  const result = new Sample(workspace, dims);
  const bits = new Uint16Array(JOB * dims);
  const weights = new Float64Array(JOB);
  const picked = new Uint16Array(JOB * dims);
  const pickedWeights = new Float64Array(JOB);
  const progress = new Progress("Sampling SH for clustering", 2 * length);
  const counts = new Float64Array(32768);
  const sums = new Float64Array(32768);
  let total = 0;
  for (let base = 0; base < length; base += JOB) {
    const count = Math.min(JOB, length - base);
    rows.weigh(base, count, weights);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const b = bucket(weights[i]);
      counts[b]++;
      sums[b] += weights[i];
      total += weights[i];
    }
    progress.update(base + count);
  }
  // The expected count falls as the step grows; at total / size it is at
  // most `size`.
  const expected = (step) => {
    let sum = 0;
    for (let b = 0; b < counts.length; b++)
      if (counts[b])
        sum += sums[b] >= step * counts[b] ? counts[b] : sums[b] / step;
    return sum;
  };
  let low = 0;
  let step = total / size;
  for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
    const middle = (low + step) / 2;
    if (expected(middle) > size) low = middle;
    else step = middle;
  }
  let light = 0;
  let next = step / 2;
  for (let base = 0; base < length; base += JOB) {
    const count = Math.min(JOB, length - base);
    rows.read(base, count, bits, weights);
    let n = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      let w = weights[i];
      if (w < step) {
        light += w;
        if (light <= next) continue;
        next += step;
        w = step;
      }
      for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++) picked[n * dims + d] = bits[i * dims + d];
      pickedWeights[n++] = w;
    }
    result.bits.write(result.length * dims, picked, n * dims);
    result.weights.write(result.length, pickedWeights, n);
    result.length += n;
    progress.update(length + base + count);
  }
  progress.finish(`${result.length} of ${length} splats`);
  return result;
}

// Writes `codes` relative to `center` in the kernel's blocks of 8 and their
// squared lengths: position i holds code order[i]. Positions without a
// code, negative or past `order`, stay infinitely far.
function layout(codes, order, dims, center, blocks, norms) {
  norms.fill(Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
  for (let i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
    const c = order[i];
    if (c < 0) continue;
    const block = Math.floor(i / BLOCK) * dims * BLOCK + (i % BLOCK);
    let norm = 0;
    for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++) {
      const value = Math.fround(codes[c * dims + d] - center[d]);
      blocks[block + d * BLOCK] = value;
      norm += value * value;
    }
    norms[i] = norm;
  }
}

const shared = (Type, items) =>
  new Type(new SharedArrayBuffer(items * Type.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT));
const identity = (count) => Int32Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => i);

// Groups codes for searches by group: k-means without weights, first from
// evenly spaced codes, then one step from the last groups, as codes move
// little between passes. Each step labels the codes with their nearest
// centers on the threads, then moves the centers to the means of their
// groups. Lays the codes out by group: the codes of each group fill whole
// blocks, and `order` maps positions to codes. Empty groups have infinitely
// far centers.
class Grouper {
  constructor(count, dims, center) {
    const blocks = Math.ceil(GROUPS / BLOCK);
    this.count = count;
    this.dims = dims;
    this.center = center;
    // The codes relative to the center, as points, and their groups.
    this.points = shared(Float32Array, count * dims);
    this.labels = shared(Uint16Array, count);
    this.means = undefined;
    this.sums = new Float64Array(GROUPS * dims);
    this.sizes = new Uint32Array(GROUPS);
    // Each group adds at most a block of fillers.
    const slots = (Math.ceil(count / BLOCK) + GROUPS) * BLOCK;
    this.layout = {
      codes: shared(Float32Array, slots * dims),
      norms: shared(Float32Array, slots),
      centers: shared(Float32Array, blocks * BLOCK * dims),
      centerNorms: shared(Float32Array, blocks * BLOCK),
      center,
    };
  }

  // Groups `codes` on the threads of `assigner` and returns their layout.
  async group(codes, assigner) {
    const { count, dims, center, points, labels, sums, sizes } = this;
    const result = this.layout;
    for (let c = 0; c < count; c++)
      for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++)
        points[c * dims + d] = codes[c * dims + d] - center[d];
    const steps = this.means ? 1 : GROUP_STEPS;
    if (!this.means) {
      this.means = new Float64Array(GROUPS * dims);
      for (let g = 0; g < GROUPS; g++) {
        const c = Math.floor((g * count) / GROUPS);
        this.means.set(codes.subarray(c * dims, (c + 1) * dims), g * dims);
      }
    }
    const { means } = this;
    for (let step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
      layout(
        means,
        identity(GROUPS),
        dims,
        center,
        result.centers,
        result.centerNorms,
      );
      await assigner.group({
        points,
        centers: result.centers,
        norms: result.centerNorms,
        labels,
        count,
      });
      sums.fill(0);
      sizes.fill(0);
      for (let c = 0; c < count; c++) {
        const g = labels[c];
        sizes[g]++;
        for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++)
          sums[g * dims + d] += codes[c * dims + d];
      }
      for (let g = 0; g < GROUPS; g++)
        if (sizes[g])
          for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++)
            means[g * dims + d] = sums[g * dims + d] / sizes[g];
    }
    const starts = new Uint32Array(GROUPS);
    const groupBlocks = new Uint32Array(GROUPS);
    let slots = 0;
    for (let g = 0; g < GROUPS; g++) {
      starts[g] = slots / BLOCK;
      groupBlocks[g] = Math.ceil(sizes[g] / BLOCK);
      slots += groupBlocks[g] * BLOCK;
    }
    const order = new Int32Array(slots).fill(-1);
    const filled = new Uint32Array(GROUPS);
    for (let c = 0; c < count; c++) {
      const g = labels[c];
      order[starts[g] * BLOCK + filled[g]++] = c;
    }
    layout(codes, order, dims, center, result.codes, result.norms);
    const nonempty = Int32Array.from({ length: GROUPS }, (_, g) =>
      sizes[g] ? g : -1,
    );
    layout(means, nonempty, dims, center, result.centers, result.centerNorms);
    return {
      ...result,
      starts,
      sizes: groupBlocks,
      // Positions that hold no code are never nearest.
      order: Uint16Array.from(order, (c) => Math.max(c, 0)),
    };
  }
}

// Clusters the splats' SH into a codebook of at most 65536 entries with
// weighted k-means as Spark does: entries start at evenly spaced splats,
// each of `iterations` moves them to the weighted mean of their splats, an
// entry without any stays, and a final pass labels each splat with its
// nearest entry. Weights are area × opacity. Training uses 10% of the
// splats, at least 64 per entry, sampled in proportion to their weights;
// with many entries, passes search only groups of them. Returns the
// entries, `count` rows of `dims` SH coefficients, and the labels.
export async function clusterSh(splats, iterations, module) {
  const { workspace, length } = splats;
  const dims = SH_DIMS.slice(0, splats.maxSh).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const count = Math.min(length, MAX_CODES);
  const all = new Rows(splats, dims);
  const samples = Math.max(
    count * SAMPLES_PER_CODE,
    Math.round(length * SAMPLE_SHARE),
  );
  const sampled = length > samples;
  const training = sampled ? sample(all, samples, workspace) : all;
  const labels = new PagedArray(workspace, Uint16Array);
  let assigner;
  try {
    const blocks = Math.ceil(count / BLOCK);
    const groups = count >= GROUPS * 32 ? GROUPS : 0;
    // Jobs are small enough for every thread to take several.
    const size = Math.max(
      4,
      Math.min(
        JOB,
        Math.ceil(training.length / (availableParallelism() * 8) / 4) * 4,
      ),
    );
    // Each thread's kernel and the buffers of its jobs: half bits, labels
    // and weights of their rows.
    const scratch = groups
      ? new WebAssembly.Instance(module, {}).exports.probed_scratch(
          BATCH,
          dims,
          groups,
          FINAL_PROBES,
        )
      : 0;
    const bytes =
      kernelBytes(dims, blocks, groups, scratch) +
      WINDOW * size * (dims * 2 + 10);
    // This thread's arrays, its own kernel and jobs when there is no room for
    // workers, and the layout of the codes; for groups, the codes as points
    // with their groups, the groups' means and sums, and the grouped layout
    // with its order.
    const slots = (blocks + groups) * BLOCK;
    const extra =
      count * (dims * 16 + 8) +
      bytes +
      (groups
        ? count * (dims * 4 + 2) +
          groups * dims * 16 +
          (slots + groups) * (dims + 1) * 4 +
          slots * 6
        : blocks * BLOCK * (dims + 1) * 4);
    // Reserve before allocating the codes and accumulators, so their memory
    // is not already in the RSS measurement that clusterers() adds to.
    const threads = clusterers(
      workspace,
      bytes,
      extra,
      Math.ceil(training.length / size),
    );
    const codes = new Float64Array(count * dims);
    const sums = new Float64Array(count * dims);
    const totals = new Float64Array(count);
    const bits = new Uint16Array(dims);
    const weight = new Float64Array(1);
    for (let c = 0; c < count; c++) {
      // Spark computes the seed rows in single precision.
      const row = Math.floor(
        Math.fround(Math.fround(c / count) * Math.fround(training.length)),
      );
      training.read(Math.min(row, training.length - 1), 1, bits, weight);
      for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++) codes[c * dims + d] = HALF[bits[d]];
    }
    // Points and codes are taken relative to the seeds' mean: the expanded
    // distances then round with the spread of the coefficients, not their
    // offset from zero.
    const center = new Float64Array(dims);
    for (let c = 0; c < count; c++)
      for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++) center[d] += codes[c * dims + d];
    for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++) center[d] /= count;
    assigner = new Assigner(module, dims, blocks, groups, threads);
    const grouper = groups && new Grouper(count, dims, center);
    const order = !groups && identity(count);
    const blocked = !groups && shared(Float32Array, blocks * BLOCK * dims);
    const norms = !groups && shared(Float32Array, blocks * BLOCK);
    // Jobs come back with their buffers, which are reused.
    const free = [];
    const take = (rows, index) => {
      workspace.check();
      const job = free.pop() ?? {
        bits: new Uint16Array(size * dims),
        labels: new Uint16Array(size),
        weights: new Float64Array(size),
      };
      job.index = index;
      job.base = index * size;
      job.count = Math.min(size, rows.length - job.base);
      rows.read(job.base, job.count, job.bits, job.weights);
      return job;
    };
    for (let pass = 0; pass <= iterations; pass++) {
      const last = pass === iterations;
      const rows = last ? all : training;
      if (grouper)
        await assigner.use("groups", {
          ...(await grouper.group(codes, assigner)),
          probes: last ? FINAL_PROBES : TRAIN_PROBES,
        });
      else {
        layout(codes, order, dims, center, blocked, norms);
        await assigner.use("codes", { codes: blocked, norms, center });
      }
      if (!last) {
        sums.fill(0);
        totals.fill(0);
      }
      let total = 0;
      let distance = 0;
      const progress = new Progress(
        `Clustering SH ${pass + 1}/${iterations + 1}`,
        rows.length,
      );
      await assigner.run(
        Math.ceil(rows.length / size),
        (index) => take(rows, index),
        (done) => {
          const { bits, weights, labels: nearest } = done;
          for (let i = 0; i < done.count; i++) {
            const c = nearest[i];
            const w = weights[i];
            let squared = 0;
            for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++) {
              const value = HALF[bits[i * dims + d]];
              const offset = value - codes[c * dims + d];
              squared += offset * offset;
              if (!last) sums[c * dims + d] += w * value;
            }
            total += w;
            if (!last) totals[c] += w;
            distance += w * squared;
          }
          if (last) labels.write(done.base, nearest, done.count);
          free.push(done);
          progress.update(done.base + done.count);
        },
      );
      progress.finish(
        `mean squared distance ${(distance / total).toExponential(3)}`,
      );
      if (last) break;
      for (let c = 0; c < count; c++)
        if (totals[c] > 0)
          for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++)
            codes[c * dims + d] = sums[c * dims + d] / totals[c];
    }
    return { count, dims, codes, labels };
  } catch (error) {
    labels.dispose();
    throw error;
  } finally {
    await assigner?.close();
    if (sampled) training.dispose();
  }
}
```

### bin/rad/grid.js
```
// Candidate search adapted from MIT-licensed code. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
import { HALF, halfBits } from "./math.js";
import { Progress } from "./progress.js";
import { IndexArray, PagedArray, Permutation } from "./storage.js";
export const NONE = 0xffffffff;
// Files over which the tables of searches spread: worker threads read their
// pages at once, and the system reads one file little faster from many.
const STRIPES = 8;
// The share of slots that cells may take. Fuller tables mean longer probes
// but fewer pages to read and write back once they no longer fit the cache.
const LOAD = 0.75;

// An entry holds Similarities.get()'s 13 terms: the center, covariance and
// log determinant as floats and the color as halves, which it is exactly.
// Then come its node, the next entry of its cell's list and, as a double,
// its merge weight, so that a search reads nothing else.
const STRIDE = 16;
const COLOR = 10;
const NODE = 12;
const LINK = 13;
const WEIGHT = 14;
const pair = new Uint32Array(2);
const double = new Float64Array(pair.buffer);
// Entries are sorted by the Morton code of their cell, 4 bits per axis and
// radix pass. Cells beyond 30 bits per axis share codes.
const BITS = 30;
const SPREAD = Uint16Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, v) => {
  let spread = 0;
  for (let bit = 0; bit < 4; bit++) spread |= ((v >> bit) & 1) << (bit * 3);
  return spread;
});

// The difference of two cells' coordinates on the axis that orders them in
// Morton order, with x varying fastest: negative when the first comes first.
function morton(a, b) {
  const below = (x, y) => x < y && x < (x ^ y);
  let high = a[0] ^ b[0];
  let difference = a[0] - b[0];
  for (let d = 1; d < 3; d++) {
    const bits = a[d] ^ b[d];
    if (!below(bits, high)) {
      high = bits;
      difference = a[d] - b[d];
    }
  }
  return difference;
}

// A set of cell hashes, cleared in constant time.
export class Cells {
  constructor(bits) {
    this.mask = (1 << bits) - 1;
    this.hashes = new Uint32Array(1 << bits);
    this.stamps = new Uint32Array(1 << bits);
    this.stamp = 1;
  }
  clear() {
    this.stamp++;
  }
  add(hash) {
    let slot = hash & this.mask;
    while (this.stamps[slot] === this.stamp && this.hashes[slot] !== hash)
      slot = (slot + 1) & this.mask;
    this.stamps[slot] = this.stamp;
    this.hashes[slot] = hash;
  }
  has(hash) {
    for (
      let slot = hash & this.mask;
      this.stamps[slot] === this.stamp;
      slot = (slot + 1) & this.mask
    )
      if (this.hashes[slot] === hash) return true;
    return false;
  }
}

// A grid table that workers can read.
function newTable(workspace) {
  const table = new PagedArray(workspace, Float32Array).share(STRIPES);
  table.wordView = true;
  return table;
}

// Copies through `scratch`: fetching the target page may evict the source's.
const scratch = new Uint32Array(STRIDE);
function copy(source, from, target, to) {
  const words = source.at(from * STRIDE).words;
  const offset = (from * STRIDE) & source.mask;
  for (let w = 0; w < STRIDE; w++) scratch[w] = words[offset + w];
  const out = target.at(to * STRIDE, true).words;
  const at = (to * STRIDE) & target.mask;
  for (let w = 0; w < STRIDE; w++) out[at + w] = scratch[w];
}

// A cell's hash XORs one term per axis. Above three bits for the cell in its
// block of 2 cells per axis, a term mixes the low and high 32 bits of the
// block's coordinate: the cells of a block take consecutive slots, so the
// cells around a query lie on few cache lines.
const LOW = [73856093, 19349663, 83492791];
const HIGH = [1640531535, 1597334677, 3812015801];
function term(value, d) {
  const block = Math.floor(value / 2);
  return (
    ((Math.imul(block, LOW[d]) ^
      Math.imul(Math.floor(block / 4294967296), HIGH[d])) <<
      3) |
    ((value - block * 2) << d)
  );
}
export function cellHash(x, y, z) {
  return (term(x, 0) ^ term(y, 1) ^ term(z, 2)) >>> 0;
}

// Finds candidates in a grid's tables: the Grid itself on the main thread,
// and workers through SharedColumns. A removed entry has its bit set in
// `gone`, so that removing one leaves the pages of entries unchanged.
export class Lookup {
  constructor(entries, slots, gone, capacity, step) {
    this.entries = entries;
    this.slots = slots;
    this.gone = gone;
    this.capacity = capacity;
    this.step = step;
    // Exact, as the step is a power of two, and faster than dividing.
    this.inverse = 1 / step;
    this.terms = new Int32Array(9);
  }

  // The slot of cell (x, y, z), or the free slot for it. A slot is a cell
  // hash and its newest entry + 1, which is 0 in free slots.
  slot(hash, x, y, z) {
    const mask = this.capacity - 1;
    for (let slot = hash & mask; ; slot = (slot + 1) & mask) {
      const words = this.slots.page(slot * 2);
      const at = this.slots.offset(slot * 2);
      const head = words[at + 1];
      if (!head) return slot;
      if (words[at] !== hash) continue;
      const floats = this.entries.page((head - 1) * STRIDE);
      const offset = this.entries.offset((head - 1) * STRIDE);
      if (
        Math.floor(floats[offset] * this.inverse) === x &&
        Math.floor(floats[offset + 1] * this.inverse) === y &&
        Math.floor(floats[offset + 2] * this.inverse) === z
      )
        return slot;
    }
  }

  // Copies an entry's similarity terms and then its weight into `out` and
  // returns its node.
  read(entry, out) {
    const page = this.entries.at(entry * STRIDE);
    const offset = this.entries.offset(entry * STRIDE);
    const { values, words } = page;
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) out[d] = values[offset + d];
    out[3] = HALF[words[offset + COLOR] & 0xffff];
    out[4] = HALF[words[offset + COLOR] >>> 16];
    out[5] = HALF[words[offset + COLOR + 1]];
    for (let d = 0; d < 7; d++) out[6 + d] = values[offset + 3 + d];
    pair[0] = words[offset + WEIGHT];
    pair[1] = words[offset + WEIGHT + 1];
    out[13] = double[0];
    return words[offset + NODE];
  }

  // Whether `entry` is removed.
  isRemoved(entry) {
    return (this.gone.get(entry >>> 5) >>> (entry & 31)) & 1;
  }

  // The most similar splat other than `index` in the 27 cells around `query`,
  // with its score in `metric`. Lists and cells are visited in reverse, and >=
  // keeps the last best score: the first best of a forward scan over lists in
  // insertion order. With `cells`, only the entries from `from` on in those
  // cells count.
  find(query, index, from = 0, cells = undefined) {
    const qx = query[0];
    const qy = query[1];
    const qz = query[2];
    const red = query[3];
    const green = query[4];
    const blue = query[5];
    const cxx = query[6];
    const cyy = query[7];
    const czz = query[8];
    const cxy = query[9];
    const cxz = query[10];
    const cyz = query[11];
    const logDet = query[12];
    const gx = Math.floor(qx * this.inverse);
    const gy = Math.floor(qy * this.inverse);
    const gz = Math.floor(qz * this.inverse);
    const terms = this.terms;
    for (let d = -1; d <= 1; d++) {
      terms[1 + d] = term(gx + d, 0);
      terms[4 + d] = term(gy + d, 1);
      terms[7 + d] = term(gz + d, 2);
    }
    const entries = this.entries;
    const gone = this.gone;
    // The word of `gone` last read.
    let word = -1;
    let bits = 0;
    let best = NONE;
    let metric = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
    let home = NONE;
    let near = NONE;
    for (let dz = 1; dz >= -1; dz--) {
      for (let dy = 1; dy >= -1; dy--) {
        for (let dx = 1; dx >= -1; dx--) {
          const hash = (terms[1 + dx] ^ terms[4 + dy] ^ terms[7 + dz]) >>> 0;
          if (cells && !cells.has(hash)) continue;
          const slot = this.slot(hash, gx + dx, gy + dy, gz + dz);
          if (!dx && !dy && !dz) home = slot;
          const head = this.slots.get(slot * 2 + 1);
          let entry = head ? head - 1 : NONE;
          // Lists run from the newest entry down.
          while (entry !== NONE && entry >= from) {
            // Before the entry's page, which reading `gone` could evict.
            if (entry >>> 5 !== word) {
              word = entry >>> 5;
              bits = gone.get(word);
            }
            const page = entries.at(entry * STRIDE);
            const b = page.values;
            const w = page.words;
            const o = entries.offset(entry * STRIDE);
            if (w[o + NODE] !== index && !((bits >>> (entry & 31)) & 1)) {
              const xx = (cxx + b[o + 3]) * 0.5;
              const yy = (cyy + b[o + 4]) * 0.5;
              const zz = (czz + b[o + 5]) * 0.5;
              const xy = (cxy + b[o + 6]) * 0.5;
              const xz = (cxz + b[o + 7]) * 0.5;
              const yz = (cyz + b[o + 8]) * 0.5;
              const det =
                xx * (yy * zz - yz * yz) -
                xy * (xy * zz - yz * xz) +
                xz * (xy * yz - yy * xz);
              const diag = Math.max(Math.abs(xx), Math.abs(yy), Math.abs(zz));
              let distance = 0;
              if (Math.abs(det) >= 1e-9 * Math.max(diag * diag * diag, 1e-30)) {
                const x = b[o] - qx;
                const y = b[o + 1] - qy;
                const z = b[o + 2] - qz;
                const quad =
                  ((yy * zz - yz * yz) * x * x +
                    (xx * zz - xz * xz) * y * y +
                    (xx * yy - xy * xy) * z * z +
                    2 *
                      ((xz * yz - xy * zz) * x * y +
                        (xy * yz - xz * yy) * x * z +
                        (xy * xz - xx * yz) * y * z)) /
                  det;
                distance =
                  0.125 * quad + 0.5 * Math.log(det) - logDet - b[o + 9];
              }
              const color = w[o + COLOR];
              const score =
                -distance -
                (red - HALF[color & 0xffff]) ** 2 -
                (green - HALF[color >>> 16]) ** 2 -
                (blue - HALF[w[o + COLOR + 1]]) ** 2;
              const value = Number.isNaN(score)
                ? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
                : score;
              if (best === NONE || value >= metric) {
                best = entry;
                metric = value;
                near = slot;
              }
            }
            entry = w[o + LINK];
          }
        }
      }
    }
    this.metric = metric;
    // The slots of the query's cell, if visited, and of the best's cell.
    this.home = home;
    this.near = near;
    return best;
  }
}

// The candidates of one LOD level. Each splat's similarity terms are computed
// once and its entry is stored in spatial order, so the cells around a query
// lie on few pages. A hash maps each cell to the newest entry of its list,
// keyed by the cell's hash and checked against that entry's center. Removed
// entries stay in the lists until compact() drops them.
export class Grid extends Lookup {
  constructor(similarities, step, bounds, pool) {
    const workspace = similarities.splats.workspace;
    super(
      newTable(workspace),
      new IndexArray(workspace).share(STRIPES),
      new IndexArray(workspace).share(STRIPES),
      16,
      step,
    );
    this.similarities = similarities;
    this.workspace = workspace;
    this.pool = pool;
    this.length = 0;
    // Bumped when slots move.
    this.layout = 0;
    // Entries below `sorted` are in key order; inserted ones follow.
    this.sorted = 0;
    this.removed = 0;
    this.count = 0;
    // The slot, cell and cell hash of the last linked entry; -1 for none.
    this.last = -1;
    this.lastX = 0;
    this.lastY = 0;
    this.lastZ = 0;
    this.lastHash = 0;
    // Node -> entry, kept up to date by link().
    this.entryOf = new IndexArray(this.workspace);
    this.tuple = new Float64Array(14);
    // Sort keys address blocks of `scale` cells per axis within the bounds:
    // single cells unless the bounds exceed 2^30 cells.
    this.origin = bounds.min.map((value) => Math.floor(value / step));
    const extent = Math.max(
      ...bounds.max.map(
        (value, d) => Math.floor(value / step) - this.origin[d] + 1,
      ),
    );
    const bits = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.log2(extent)));
    this.scale = 2 ** Math.max(0, bits - BITS);
    this.limit = 2 ** Math.min(bits, BITS) - 1;
    this.passes = Math.ceil(Math.min(bits, BITS) / 4);
    this.a = new Int32Array(3);
    this.b = new Int32Array(3);
  }

  // The coordinates of the block of an entry's cell, into `out`.
  block(table, entry, out) {
    const values = table.page(entry * STRIDE);
    const offset = (entry * STRIDE) & table.mask;
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++)
      out[d] = Math.min(
        this.limit,
        Math.max(
          0,
          Math.floor(
            (Math.floor(values[offset + d] * this.inverse) - this.origin[d]) /
              this.scale,
          ),
        ),
      );
    return out;
  }

  // Adds the active splats that are not removed, in heap order.
  build(active, removed, label) {
    const progress = label && new Progress(`${label} grid`, active.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < active.length; i++) {
      const node = active.index(i);
      if (!removed.get(node)) this.add(node);
      if ((i & 4095) === 0) progress?.update(i);
    }
    progress?.finish();
    this.entries = this.sort(this.entries, this.length, label);
    this.sorted = this.length;
    this.relink(label);
  }

  // Adds a merged splat during the level, with its terms if known, and
  // returns the hash of its cell.
  insert(node, weight, terms, slot = NONE) {
    this.add(node, weight, terms);
    this.link(this.length - 1, slot);
    return this.lastHash;
  }

  // Without terms, reads the splat's terms and weight.
  add(node, weight, terms) {
    const tuple = terms ?? this.similarities.get(node, this.tuple);
    const entry = this.length++;
    const { values, words } = this.entries.at(entry * STRIDE, true);
    const offset = (entry * STRIDE) & this.entries.mask;
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) values[offset + d] = tuple[d];
    for (let d = 0; d < 7; d++) values[offset + 3 + d] = tuple[6 + d];
    words[offset + COLOR] = halfBits(tuple[3]) | (halfBits(tuple[4]) << 16);
    words[offset + COLOR + 1] = halfBits(tuple[5]);
    words[offset + NODE] = node;
    words[offset + LINK] = NONE;
    double[0] = terms ? weight : tuple[13];
    words[offset + WEIGHT] = pair[0];
    words[offset + WEIGHT + 1] = pair[1];
  }

  // Returns the first `length` entries of `table` stably sorted by block,
  // disposing `table` if they moved. Sorts each entry's block and position,
  // four words, and then moves the entries once.
  sort(table, length, label) {
    const passes = this.passes;
    const progress =
      label && new Progress(`${label} spatial sort`, length * (passes + 2));
    const digit = (words, o, pass) =>
      SPREAD[(words[o] >>> (pass * 4)) & 15] |
      (SPREAD[(words[o + 1] >>> (pass * 4)) & 15] << 1) |
      (SPREAD[(words[o + 2] >>> (pass * 4)) & 15] << 2);
    const counts = Array.from({ length: passes }, () => new Float64Array(4096));
    const block = this.a;
    let keys = new IndexArray(this.workspace);
    for (let entry = 0; entry < length; entry++) {
      this.block(table, entry, block);
      const words = keys.page(entry * 4, true);
      const o = (entry * 4) & keys.mask;
      words[o] = block[0];
      words[o + 1] = block[1];
      words[o + 2] = block[2];
      words[o + 3] = entry;
      for (let pass = 0; pass < passes; pass++)
        counts[pass][digit(words, o, pass)]++;
      if ((entry & 4095) === 0) progress?.update(entry);
    }
    let moved = false;
    for (let pass = 0; pass < passes; pass++) {
      const cursor = counts[pass];
      if (cursor.includes(length)) continue;
      for (let b = 0, sum = 0; b < 4096; b++) {
        const count = cursor[b];
        cursor[b] = sum;
        sum += count;
      }
      const sorted = new IndexArray(this.workspace);
      for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        const words = keys.page(i * 4);
        const o = (i * 4) & keys.mask;
        const x = words[o];
        const y = words[o + 1];
        const z = words[o + 2];
        const entry = words[o + 3];
        const t = cursor[digit(words, o, pass)]++ * 4;
        const out = sorted.page(t, true);
        const at = t & sorted.mask;
        out[at] = x;
        out[at + 1] = y;
        out[at + 2] = z;
        out[at + 3] = entry;
        if ((i & 4095) === 0) progress?.update(length * (pass + 1) + i);
      }
      keys.dispose();
      keys = sorted;
      moved = true;
    }
    if (!moved) {
      keys.dispose();
      progress?.finish();
      return table;
    }
    const indices = new IndexArray(this.workspace);
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      indices.push(keys.get(i * 4 + 3));
      if ((i & 4095) === 0) progress?.update(length * (passes + 1) + i);
    }
    keys.dispose();
    progress?.finish();
    const permutation = new Permutation(
      this.workspace,
      indices,
      length,
      label && `${label} spatial order`,
    );
    indices.dispose();
    const sorted = permutation.apply(
      table,
      STRIDE,
      this.pool,
      true,
      label && `${label} spatial reorder`,
    );
    permutation.dispose();
    return sorted;
  }

  // Drops removed entries and merges the inserted ones, sorted, into the
  // rest. Entries with equal keys keep their order.
  compact() {
    const old = this.entries;
    let inserted = newTable(this.workspace);
    let added = 0;
    for (let entry = this.sorted; entry < this.length; entry++)
      if (!this.isRemoved(entry)) copy(old, entry, inserted, added++);
    inserted = this.sort(inserted, added);
    this.entries = newTable(this.workspace);
    let length = 0;
    for (let i = 0, j = 0; ; ) {
      while (i < this.sorted && this.isRemoved(i)) i++;
      if (i === this.sorted && j === added) break;
      if (
        j === added ||
        (i < this.sorted &&
          morton(this.block(old, i, this.a), this.block(inserted, j, this.b)) <=
            0)
      )
        copy(old, i++, this.entries, length++);
      else copy(inserted, j++, this.entries, length++);
    }
    old.dispose();
    inserted.dispose();
    this.gone.dispose();
    this.gone = new IndexArray(this.workspace).share(STRIPES);
    this.length = this.sorted = length;
    this.removed = 0;
    this.relink();
  }

  // Rebuilds the lists in entry order. Entries of a cell are in insertion
  // order, so each list runs from the newest entry to the oldest.
  relink(label) {
    const progress = label && new Progress(`${label} indexing`, this.length);
    this.slots.dispose();
    this.slots = new IndexArray(this.workspace).share(STRIPES);
    // Compaction keeps at most the cells there were.
    this.capacity = 16;
    while (this.capacity * LOAD <= this.count) this.capacity *= 2;
    this.count = 0;
    this.last = -1;
    this.layout++;
    for (let entry = 0; entry < this.length; entry++) {
      this.link(entry);
      if ((entry & 4095) === 0) progress?.update(entry);
    }
    progress?.finish();
  }

  // Prepends `entry` to the list of its cell.
  link(entry, hint = NONE) {
    const page = this.entries.at(entry * STRIDE);
    const offset = (entry * STRIDE) & this.entries.mask;
    const node = page.words[offset + NODE];
    const x = Math.floor(page.values[offset] * this.inverse);
    const y = Math.floor(page.values[offset + 1] * this.inverse);
    const z = Math.floor(page.values[offset + 2] * this.inverse);
    this.entryOf.set(node, entry);
    // Entries in spatial order often share the last entry's cell.
    let slot = this.last;
    if (hint !== NONE) {
      slot = hint;
      this.lastHash = this.slots.get(hint * 2);
    } else if (
      slot < 0 ||
      x !== this.lastX ||
      y !== this.lastY ||
      z !== this.lastZ
    ) {
      if (
        !Number.isSafeInteger(x) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(y) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(z)
      )
        throw new Error(
          "Splat coordinates exceed the LOD grid's integer range",
        );
      this.lastHash = (term(x, 0) ^ term(y, 1) ^ term(z, 2)) >>> 0;
      slot = this.slot(this.lastHash, x, y, z);
    }
    const head = this.slots.get(slot * 2 + 1);
    this.entries.at(entry * STRIDE, true).words[offset + LINK] = head
      ? head - 1
      : NONE;
    this.slots.set(slot * 2 + 1, entry + 1);
    this.last = slot;
    this.lastX = x;
    this.lastY = y;
    this.lastZ = z;
    if (!head) {
      this.slots.set(slot * 2, this.lastHash);
      if (++this.count >= this.capacity * LOAD) this.grow();
    }
  }

  grow() {
    this.last = -1;
    this.layout++;
    const old = this.slots;
    const capacity = this.capacity;
    this.capacity *= 2;
    this.slots = new IndexArray(this.workspace).share(STRIPES);
    const mask = this.capacity - 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < capacity; i++) {
      const head = old.get(i * 2 + 1);
      if (!head) continue;
      const hash = old.get(i * 2);
      let slot = hash & mask;
      while (this.slots.get(slot * 2 + 1)) slot = (slot + 1) & mask;
      this.slots.set(slot * 2, hash);
      this.slots.set(slot * 2 + 1, head);
    }
    old.dispose();
  }

  remove(entry) {
    const word = entry >>> 5;
    this.gone.set(word, this.gone.get(word) | (1 << (entry & 31)));
    this.removed++;
  }

  // The entry of `node`, which must be in the grid.
  entry(node) {
    return this.entryOf.get(node);
  }

  // Compacts the grid once half of it is removed. Entries keep their
  // positions until the next call.
  tidy() {
    if (this.removed * 2 > this.length) this.compact();
  }

  dispose() {
    this.entries.dispose();
    this.slots.dispose();
    this.gone.dispose();
    this.entryOf.dispose();
  }
}
```

### bin/rad/heap.js
```
import { Progress } from "./progress.js";
import { IndexArray } from "./storage.js";

const float = new Float32Array(1);
const bits = new Uint32Array(float.buffer);
// An unsigned integer that orders like the float score; -0 counts as 0.
function rank(score) {
  float[0] = score + 0;
  const word = bits[0];
  return (word & 0x80000000 ? ~word : word | 0x80000000) >>> 0;
}

// Whether item (key, index) pops before item (otherKey, otherIndex).
function above(key, index, otherKey, otherIndex) {
  return key > otherKey || (key === otherKey && index > otherIndex);
}

// The pages of an IndexArray in one growing array, for heaps that stay small.
class Flat {
  constructor() {
    this.values = new Uint32Array(1024);
    this.mask = 0xffffffff;
  }
  page(index) {
    if (index + 2 > this.values.length) {
      const larger = new Uint32Array(
        Math.max(index + 2, this.values.length * 2),
      );
      larger.set(this.values);
      this.values = larger;
    }
    return this.values;
  }
  get(index) {
    return this.page(index)[index];
  }
  dispose() {}
}

// Each item is a (rank, index) pair of words, so visiting it reads one page.
// Of equal ranks, the larger index pops first.
export class Heap {
  constructor(workspace, flat = false) {
    this.items = flat ? new Flat() : new IndexArray(workspace);
    this.length = 0;
  }
  // Whether the top item pops before the item (key, index).
  before(key, index) {
    const words = this.items.page(0);
    return above(words[0], words[1], key, index);
  }
  index(i) {
    return this.items.get(i * 2 + 1);
  }
  store(i, key, index) {
    const words = this.items.page(i * 2, true);
    const offset = (i * 2) & this.items.mask;
    words[offset] = key;
    words[offset + 1] = index;
  }
  push(index, score) {
    this.pushKey(index, rank(score));
  }
  pushKey(index, key) {
    let i = this.length++;
    while (i > 0) {
      const parent = Math.floor((i - 1) / 2);
      const words = this.items.page(parent * 2);
      const offset = (parent * 2) & this.items.mask;
      const otherKey = words[offset];
      const other = words[offset + 1];
      if (!above(key, index, otherKey, other)) break;
      this.store(i, otherKey, other);
      i = parent;
    }
    this.store(i, key, index);
  }
  pop() {
    const items = this.items;
    const result = items.get(1);
    // The popped item's key.
    this.key = items.get(0);
    const last = --this.length;
    const tail = items.page(last * 2);
    const key = tail[(last * 2) & items.mask];
    const index = tail[((last * 2) & items.mask) + 1];
    let i = 0;
    // Down to the items whose children leave the first page, one view of it
    // serves: no other page is read meanwhile, so none is evicted.
    const first = Math.min(last, (items.mask + 1) / 2);
    const top = items.page(0, true);
    let placed = false;
    while (i * 2 + 2 < first) {
      let child = i * 2 + 1;
      let childKey = top[child * 2];
      let childIndex = top[child * 2 + 1];
      const rightKey = top[child * 2 + 2];
      const rightIndex = top[child * 2 + 3];
      if (above(rightKey, rightIndex, childKey, childIndex)) {
        child++;
        childKey = rightKey;
        childIndex = rightIndex;
      }
      if (above(key, index, childKey, childIndex)) {
        placed = true;
        break;
      }
      top[i * 2] = childKey;
      top[i * 2 + 1] = childIndex;
      i = child;
    }
    while (!placed && i * 2 + 1 < last) {
      let child = i * 2 + 1;
      const left = items.page(child * 2);
      let childKey = left[(child * 2) & items.mask];
      let childIndex = left[((child * 2) & items.mask) + 1];
      if (child + 1 < last) {
        const right = items.page(child * 2 + 2);
        const rightKey = right[(child * 2 + 2) & items.mask];
        const rightIndex = right[((child * 2 + 2) & items.mask) + 1];
        if (above(rightKey, rightIndex, childKey, childIndex)) {
          child++;
          childKey = rightKey;
          childIndex = rightIndex;
        }
      }
      if (above(key, index, childKey, childIndex)) break;
      this.store(i, childKey, childIndex);
      i = child;
    }
    if (last) this.store(i, key, index);
    return result;
  }
  dispose() {
    this.items.dispose();
  }
}

// Pops the items of a heap with ties broken toward larger indices in the
// same order as the heap: the items it holds now from a sorted copy, and items
// pushed later from a second heap. Popping a sorted copy reads it in order.
export class Queue {
  constructor(heap, workspace, label) {
    this.size = heap.length;
    this.items = sortItems(heap.items, this.size, workspace, false, label);
    this.cursor = 0;
    this.fresh = new Heap(workspace);
    // The popped item's key.
    this.key = 0;
  }
  get length() {
    return this.size - this.cursor + this.fresh.length;
  }
  // Whether the next item pops before the item (key, index).
  before(key, index) {
    if (this.fresh.length && this.fresh.before(key, index)) return true;
    if (this.cursor === this.size) return false;
    const words = this.items.page(this.cursor * 2);
    const offset = (this.cursor * 2) & this.items.mask;
    return above(words[offset], words[offset + 1], key, index);
  }
  pop() {
    if (this.cursor < this.size) {
      const words = this.items.page(this.cursor * 2);
      const offset = (this.cursor * 2) & this.items.mask;
      const key = words[offset];
      const index = words[offset + 1];
      if (!this.fresh.length || !this.fresh.before(key, index)) {
        this.cursor++;
        this.key = key;
        return index;
      }
    }
    const index = this.fresh.pop();
    this.key = this.fresh.key;
    return index;
  }
  push(index, score) {
    this.fresh.push(index, score);
  }
  dispose() {
    this.items.dispose();
    this.fresh.dispose();
  }
}

// The first `count` (key, index) items of `items`, sorted by descending key
// and then index, or by key alone if `byKey`, keeping the order of items with
// equal keys: a radix sort by byte, skipping bytes that all items share.
function sortItems(items, count, workspace, byKey = false, label = undefined) {
  const first = byKey ? 4 : 0;
  const progress = label && new Progress(label, count * (10 - first));
  const counts = Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => new Float64Array(256));
  // Byte `pass` of the index, then of the key, inverted to sort descending.
  const digit = (key, index, pass) =>
    255 - (((pass < 4 ? index : key) >>> ((pass & 3) * 8)) & 255);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const words = items.page(i * 2);
    const offset = (i * 2) & items.mask;
    for (let pass = first; pass < 8; pass++)
      counts[pass][digit(words[offset], words[offset + 1], pass)]++;
    if ((i & 4095) === 0) progress?.update(i);
  }
  let source = items;
  for (let pass = first; pass < 8; pass++) {
    const cursor = counts[pass];
    if (cursor.includes(count)) continue;
    for (let b = 0, sum = 0; b < 256; b++) {
      const size = cursor[b];
      cursor[b] = sum;
      sum += size;
    }
    const sorted = new IndexArray(workspace);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const words = source.page(i * 2);
      const offset = (i * 2) & source.mask;
      const key = words[offset];
      const index = words[offset + 1];
      const target = cursor[digit(key, index, pass)]++ * 2;
      const out = sorted.page(target, true);
      out[target & sorted.mask] = key;
      out[(target & sorted.mask) + 1] = index;
      if ((i & 4095) === 0) progress?.update(count * (1 + pass - first) + i);
    }
    if (source !== items) source.dispose();
    source = sorted;
  }
  if (source !== items) {
    progress?.finish();
    return source;
  }
  const copy = new IndexArray(workspace);
  for (let i = 0; i < count * 2; i++) {
    copy.set(i, items.get(i));
    if ((i & 4095) === 0) progress?.update(count * (9 - first) + i / 2);
  }
  progress?.finish();
  return copy;
}

// Sorts the splats by feature size, and splats of equal size by index.
export function sortSplats(splats, pool) {
  const workspace = splats.workspace;
  const count = splats.length;
  const progress = new Progress("Preparing splat sort", count);
  // Sorted by descending rank, the smallest feature comes first; sorting by
  // rank alone keeps splats of equal size in index order.
  const items = new IndexArray(workspace);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const key = rank(-splats.feature(i));
    const words = items.page(i * 2, true);
    const offset = (i * 2) & items.mask;
    words[offset] = key;
    words[offset + 1] = i;
    if ((i & 4095) === 0) progress.update(i);
  }
  progress.finish();
  const sorted = sortItems(items, count, workspace, true, "Sorting splats");
  items.dispose();
  const order = new IndexArray(workspace);
  const ordering = new Progress("Collecting splat order", count);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    order.push(sorted.get(i * 2 + 1));
    if ((i & 4095) === 0) ordering.update(i);
  }
  sorted.dispose();
  ordering.finish();
  splats.reorder(order, pool);
  order.dispose();
}
