### bin/rad/input.js
```
import {
  closeSync,
  fstatSync,
  openSync,
  readFileSync,
  readSync,
} from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import init, { RawDecoder } from "../decoder/decoder.js";
import { Progress } from "./progress.js";
import { Splats } from "./splats.js";

let wasm;
// A trapped WebAssembly instance is unusable, and this process cannot load a
// second copy of the module, so later inputs fail with this error instead.
let crashed;
function initialize() {
  wasm ??= init({
    module_or_path: readFileSync(
      new URL("../decoder/decoder_bg.wasm", import.meta.url),
    ),
  });
  return wasm;
}

export async function readInput(input, maxSh, workspace) {
  const extension = path.extname(input).toLowerCase();
  if (extension !== ".ply" && extension !== ".spz") {
    throw new Error("Input must be a .ply or .spz file");
  }
  if (crashed) {
    throw new Error(
      `Skipped after the decoder failed on an earlier input (${crashed.message}); convert this file in a new run`,
    );
  }
  const backend = await initialize();
  const splats = new Splats(workspace, maxSh);
  // The decoder asks for `base` bytes of linear memory for each batch; the
  // workspace measures that memory with the rest of the process once it
  // has grown.
  const callback = (name, base, values) => {
    if (name !== "memory") splats.receive(name, base, values);
    else if (base > backend.memory.buffer.byteLength)
      workspace.expect(base - backend.memory.buffer.byteLength);
  };
  const fd = openSync(input, "r");
  try {
    const size = fstatSync(fd).size;
    const progress = new Progress("Reading input", size);
    const decoder = new RawDecoder(input, size, callback);
    try {
      const bytes = Buffer.allocUnsafe(1024 * 1024);
      let read = 0;
      for (;;) {
        workspace.check();
        const size = readSync(fd, bytes);
        if (!size) break;
        decoder.push(bytes.subarray(0, size));
        read += size;
        progress.update(read);
      }
      decoder.finish();
    } catch (error) {
      // A trap leaves the decoder borrowed; free() would then throw and hide
      // the original error.
      try {
        decoder.free();
      } catch {}
      throw error;
    }
    decoder.free();
    progress.finish(`${splats.length} splats, SH${splats.inputSh}`);
    return splats;
  } catch (error) {
    splats.dispose();
    if (error instanceof WebAssembly.RuntimeError) {
      crashed = error;
      throw new Error(
        `Decoder failed with an internal error (${error.message})`,
        { cause: error },
      );
    }
    throw error;
  } finally {
    closeSync(fd);
  }
}
```

### bin/rad/lod.js
```
// LOD construction adapted from MIT-licensed code. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
import { Cells, Grid, NONE, cellHash } from "./grid.js";
import { Heap, Queue, sortSplats } from "./heap.js";
import { SCALE, halfBits, rotation } from "./math.js";
import { MISS, ROUND, hint } from "./parallel.js";
import { Progress } from "./progress.js";
import { SH_DIMS, Similarities } from "./splats.js";
import { IndexArray, PagedArray, Permutation } from "./storage.js";

export function buildLod(splats, lodBase, pool) {
  const initial = splats.length;
  const workspace = splats.workspace;
  sortSplats(splats, pool);
  mergeLevels(splats, pool);
  splats.mergeSh(initial, pool);
  const root = splats.length - 1;

  // Children always precede their binary parent: the two of merged splat
  // `index` are entries 2 * (index - initial) and the next of `children`. A
  // merged splat is kept if its weight is at least lodBase times its
  // children's largest feature; one that is not passes that feature on, and
  // its kept descendants become children of its kept ancestor.
  const features = new PagedArray(workspace, Float64Array);
  const selection = new Progress("Selecting LOD nodes", splats.length);
  let retainedCount = initial;
  for (let index = 0; index < initial; index++) {
    features.set(index, splats.weight.get(index));
    if ((index & 4095) === 0) selection.update(index);
  }
  // A bit for each merged splat.
  const kept = new IndexArray(workspace);
  for (let index = initial; index < splats.length; index++) {
    let maximum = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
    for (let c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
      const child = splats.children.get((index - initial) * 2 + c);
      maximum = Math.max(maximum, features.get(child));
    }
    const feature = splats.weight.get(index);
    const retained = index === root || feature >= maximum * lodBase;
    features.set(index, retained ? feature : maximum);
    if (retained) {
      retainedCount++;
      const bit = index - initial;
      kept.set(bit >>> 5, kept.get(bit >>> 5) | (1 << (bit & 31)));
    }
    if ((index & 4095) === 0) selection.update(index);
  }
  features.dispose();
  splats.weight.dispose();
  selection.finish(`${retainedCount} nodes retained`);

  // Ordering reads sizes at random; a copy without the rest of each record
  // stays cached.
  const sizes = new PagedArray(workspace, Float32Array);
  const sizing = new Progress("Reading LOD sizes", splats.length);
  for (let index = 0; index < splats.length; index++) {
    sizes.set(index, splats.feature(index));
    if ((index & 4095) === 0) sizing.update(index);
  }
  sizing.finish();
  // A splat's logical index is its position in `order`. Its children get
  // consecutive logical indices: `first` and the `counts` - 1 after it.
  const order = new IndexArray(workspace);
  const first = new IndexArray(workspace);
  const counts = new IndexArray(workspace);
  order.push(root);
  // The splats to visit, by logical index, splat and size: the frontier of a
  // pass as triples of words, and a stack within it.
  let frontier = new IndexArray(workspace);
  frontier.push(0);
  frontier.push(root);
  frontier.push(bitsOf(sizes.get(root)));
  let logicals = new Uint32Array(64);
  let indices = new Uint32Array(64);
  let lengths = new Float32Array(64);
  let list = new Uint32Array(64);
  let walk = new Uint32Array(64);
  const ordering = new Progress("Ordering LOD tree", retainedCount);
  let visited = 0;
  for (let limit = sizes.get(root); ; limit /= 4) {
    const next = new IndexArray(workspace);
    for (let f = 0; f < frontier.length; f += 3) {
      logicals[0] = frontier.get(f);
      indices[0] = frontier.get(f + 1);
      lengths[0] = floatOf(frontier.get(f + 2));
      let top = 1;
      while (top) {
        if ((++visited & 4095) === 0) ordering.update(order.length);
        top--;
        const logical = logicals[top];
        const index = indices[top];
        if (lengths[top] < limit) {
          next.push(logical);
          next.push(index);
          next.push(bitsOf(lengths[top]));
          continue;
        }
        if (index < initial) continue;
        // Its children: the kept splats below it, through those not kept.
        let count = 0;
        let depth = 0;
        walk[depth++] = index;
        while (depth) {
          const pair = (walk[--depth] - initial) * 2;
          for (let c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            const child = splats.children.get(pair + c);
            const bit = child - initial;
            if (child < initial || (kept.get(bit >>> 5) >>> (bit & 31)) & 1) {
              if (count === list.length) list = grow(list, count);
              list[count++] = child;
            } else {
              if (depth === walk.length) walk = grow(walk, depth);
              walk[depth++] = child;
            }
          }
        }
        if (count > 65535)
          throw new Error("LOD child count exceeds RAD u16 limit");
        sort(list, count);
        const start = order.length;
        first.set(logical, start);
        counts.set(logical, count);
        for (let c = 0; c < count; c++) order.push(list[c]);
        if (top + count > logicals.length) {
          logicals = grow(logicals, top, top + count);
          indices = grow(indices, top, top + count);
          lengths = grow(lengths, top, top + count);
        }
        for (let c = count - 1; c >= 0; c--) {
          logicals[top] = start + c;
          indices[top] = list[c];
          lengths[top++] = sizes.get(list[c]);
        }
      }
    }
    frontier.dispose();
    if (!next.length) {
      next.dispose();
      break;
    }
    frontier = next;
  }
  sizes.dispose();
  kept.dispose();
  ordering.finish();
  chunkTree(splats, order, first, counts, pool);
  order.dispose();
}

// Merges the splats level by level into a binary tree, adding the merged
// splats after the leaves.
function mergeLevels(splats, pool) {
  const initial = splats.length;
  const workspace = splats.workspace;
  // Merged splats lie within the leaves' bounds. merge() reads the leaves'
  // weights.
  const bounds = {
    min: [0, 1, 2].map(() => Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY),
    max: [0, 1, 2].map(() => Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY),
  };
  const record = new Float64Array(16);
  const preparing = new Progress("Preparing LOD bounds", initial);
  for (let i = 0; i < initial; i++) {
    splats.read(i, record);
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
      bounds.min[d] = Math.min(bounds.min[d], record[d]);
      bounds.max[d] = Math.max(bounds.max[d], record[d]);
    }
    splats.weight.set(i, record[15] * record[3]);
    if ((i & 4095) === 0) preparing.update(i);
  }
  preparing.finish();
  const removed = new PagedArray(workspace, Uint8Array);
  const similarities = new Similarities(splats);
  let active = new Heap(workspace);
  let frontier = 0;
  // The similarity terms and weight of a popped splat and of the splat it
  // merges with.
  const query = new Float64Array(14);
  const candidate = new Float64Array(14);
  const keys = new Uint32Array(ROUND);
  // A worker's merged record and its terms.
  const merge = new Float32Array(16);
  const terms13 = new Float32Array(13);
  // Cells that merges of the round have added entries to, and the blocks of
  // 4 cells per axis next to them: queries in other blocks skip the check.
  const added = new Cells(18);
  const near = new Cells(20);
  for (
    let level = Math.ceil(Math.log2(Math.max(splats.feature(0), 0.000001)));
    ;
    level++
  ) {
    const step = 2 ** level;
    if (!Number.isFinite(step)) throw new Error("LOD scale overflow");
    // The leaves are sorted by feature, so find this level's range without
    // an extra linear pass just to count its work.
    let low = frontier;
    let high = initial;
    while (low < high) {
      const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
      if (splats.feature(middle) <= step) low = middle + 1;
      else high = middle;
    }
    const { grid, queue } = Progress.inline(() => {
      const adding = new Progress(`Preparing level ${level}`, low - frontier);
      const previous = frontier;
      while (frontier < low) {
        active.push(frontier, -splats.feature(frontier));
        frontier++;
        if ((frontier & 4095) === 0) adding.update(frontier - previous);
      }
      adding.finish();
      const grid = new Grid(similarities, step, bounds, pool);
      grid.build(active, removed, `Level ${level}`);
      const queue = new Queue(
        active,
        workspace,
        `Sorting level ${level} queue`,
      );
      return { grid, queue };
    });
    active.dispose();
    const next = new Heap(workspace);
    const detail = () =>
      `${frontier}/${initial} leaves, ${queue.length} pending, ${splats.length} splats`;
    const progress = new Progress(`Level ${level}`, queue.length, detail());
    // Rounds of merges in heap order. Workers search for the candidates of
    // the next popped splats against the grid at the start of the round.
    // Committing them in order, a search still holds unless its candidate is
    // gone or a merge of the round added a candidate at least as good, and
    // splats that merges add pop as they would one by one.
    while (queue.length) {
      grid.tidy();
      const limit = Math.min(
        ROUND,
        Math.max(256, Math.floor(grid.count / 100)),
      );
      let count = 0;
      while (count < limit && queue.length) {
        const index = queue.pop();
        if (removed.get(index)) continue;
        pool.nodes[count] = index;
        pool.entries[count] = grid.entry(index);
        keys[count] = queue.key;
        count++;
      }
      // Entries from here on are added by the round; slots stay put while
      // the layout does.
      const start = grid.length;
      const layout = grid.layout;
      if (count < 64) pool.results.fill(MISS, 0, count);
      else pool.search(grid, count);
      added.clear();
      near.clear();
      for (let t = 0; t < count; ) {
        let index;
        let self;
        let key;
        let best = MISS;
        let task = -1;
        if (queue.length && queue.before(keys[t], pool.nodes[t])) {
          index = queue.pop();
          key = queue.key;
          if (removed.get(index)) continue;
          self = grid.entry(index);
        } else {
          index = pool.nodes[t];
          self = pool.entries[t];
          key = keys[t];
          best = pool.results[t];
          task = t++;
          if (removed.get(index)) continue;
        }
        // A search that the main thread need not do passes on the terms.
        if (best === MISS) grid.read(self, query);
        else
          for (let d = 0; d < 14; d++) query[d] = pool.queries[task * 14 + d];
        if (best !== MISS && best !== NONE && grid.isRemoved(best)) best = MISS;
        const inverse = grid.inverse;
        if (
          best !== MISS &&
          near.has(
            cellHash(
              Math.floor(Math.floor(query[0] * inverse) / 4),
              Math.floor(Math.floor(query[1] * inverse) / 4),
              Math.floor(Math.floor(query[2] * inverse) / 4),
            ),
          )
        ) {
          const better = grid.find(query, index, start, added);
          if (better !== NONE) {
            const metric = pool.metrics[task];
            if (best === NONE || grid.metric > metric) {
              best = better;
              task = -1;
            } else if (grid.metric === metric) best = MISS;
          }
        }
        if (best === MISS) {
          best = grid.find(query, index);
          task = -1;
        }
        if (best === NONE) {
          // Its key in the queue is its feature's.
          next.pushKey(index, key);
          continue;
        }
        const other =
          task < 0 ? grid.read(best, candidate) : pool.partners[task];
        // A search that still holds was merged with the same inputs.
        const merged =
          task < 0
            ? splats.merge(index, other, query, candidate)
            : splats.append(
                index,
                other,
                copy(pool.records, task * 16, merge, 16),
                pool.blends[task * 2],
                pool.blends[task * 2 + 1],
              );
        removed.set(index, 1);
        removed.set(other, 1);
        grid.remove(self);
        grid.remove(best);
        const feature = splats.feature(merged);
        if (feature > step) next.push(merged, -feature);
        else {
          const terms =
            task < 0 ? undefined : copy(pool.terms, task * 13, terms13, 13);
          // The slot of its cell where the search found it.
          const slot =
            task < 0
              ? hint(grid, splats.merged, query, candidate)
              : layout === grid.layout
                ? pool.hints[task]
                : NONE;
          added.add(
            grid.insert(merged, splats.weight.get(merged), terms, slot),
          );
          const { lastX: x, lastY: y, lastZ: z } = grid;
          const x1 = Math.floor((x + 1) / 4);
          const y1 = Math.floor((y + 1) / 4);
          const z1 = Math.floor((z + 1) / 4);
          for (let bz = Math.floor((z - 1) / 4); bz <= z1; bz++)
            for (let by = Math.floor((y - 1) / 4); by <= y1; by++)
              for (let bx = Math.floor((x - 1) / 4); bx <= x1; bx++)
                near.add(cellHash(bx, by, bz));
          queue.push(merged, -feature);
        }
      }
      // At round boundaries the queue only shrinks: each new merged item
      // replaces at least one popped item. Include those items until drained.
      progress.update(progress.total - queue.length, detail());
    }
    grid.dispose();
    queue.dispose();
    progress.finish(detail());
    active = next;
    if (frontier === initial && active.length <= 1) break;
  }
  active.dispose();
  removed.dispose();
}

// A copy of the first `count` values of `array` with room for `size`.
function grow(array, count, size = count + 1) {
  const larger = new array.constructor(size * 2);
  larger.set(array.subarray(0, count));
  return larger;
}

// Sizes in words of an IndexArray.
const float = new Float32Array(1);
const word = new Uint32Array(float.buffer);
function bitsOf(value) {
  float[0] = value;
  return word[0];
}
function floatOf(bits) {
  word[0] = bits;
  return float[0];
}

// Copies `count` values of `source` from `from` into `out`, and returns it.
function copy(source, from, out, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) out[i] = source[from + i];
  return out;
}

// Sorts the first `count` values ascending.
function sort(values, count) {
  if (count > 32) {
    values.subarray(0, count).sort();
    return;
  }
  for (let i = 1; i < count; i++) {
    const value = values[i];
    let j = i;
    for (; j > 0 && values[j - 1] > value; j--) values[j] = values[j - 1];
    values[j] = value;
  }
}

// Lays out the tree in chunks of 65536 splats and moves every column into
// that order. Children become consecutive rows: childStart is then the row of
// a splat's first child.
function chunkTree(splats, order, first, counts, pool) {
  const workspace = splats.workspace;
  const nodes = splats.length;
  for (const column of [splats.childStart, splats.childCount, splats.children])
    column.dispose();
  // Chunking reads records at random by logical index, so it reads them in
  // logical order, where splats of a subtree lie close together.
  const logical = new Permutation(
    workspace,
    order,
    nodes,
    "Preparing LOD order",
  );
  splats.records = logical.apply(
    splats.records,
    16,
    pool,
    false,
    "Reordering LOD nodes",
  );
  logical.dispose();
  const sizes = new PagedArray(workspace, Float32Array);
  const sizing = new Progress("Reading chunk sizes", order.length);
  for (let index = 0; index < order.length; index++) {
    sizes.set(index, splats.feature(index));
    if ((index & 4095) === 0) sizing.update(index);
  }
  sizing.finish();
  // The row of each splat's first child.
  const starts = new PagedArray(workspace, Float64Array);
  const indices = new IndexArray(workspace);
  indices.push(0);
  const top = new IndexArray(workspace);
  top.push(0);
  const batches = [top];
  const record = new Float64Array(16);
  const r = new Float64Array(9);
  // Splats without children add no rows when they pop, so they wait outside
  // the heap with the number of pops before them: one pops unless all later
  // pops rank above it.
  let leaves = new Uint32Array(1024);
  let leafSizes = new Float32Array(1024);
  let since = new Uint32Array(1024);
  let waiting = 0;
  // The splats that pop from the heap, and their sizes.
  let popped = new Uint32Array(1024);
  let poppedSizes = new Float32Array(1024);
  let pops = 0;
  const add = (heap, index) => {
    const size = sizes.get(index);
    if (counts.get(index)) heap.push(index, size);
    else {
      if (waiting === leaves.length) {
        leaves = grow(leaves, waiting);
        leafSizes = grow(leafSizes, waiting);
        since = grow(since, waiting);
      }
      leaves[waiting] = index;
      leafSizes[waiting] = size;
      since[waiting++] = pops;
    }
  };
  const chunking = new Progress("Arranging LOD chunks", order.length);
  for (let b = 0; b < batches.length; b++) {
    const batch = batches[b];
    batches[b] = undefined;
    const heap = new Heap(workspace, true);
    waiting = 0;
    pops = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < batch.length; i++) add(heap, batch.get(i));
    batch.dispose();
    const start = indices.length;
    let end = Math.ceil((start + 8192) / 65536) * 65536;
    // The splats without children that stay: the last `stayed` of `leaves`,
    // from `stay` on.
    let stay = 0;
    let stayed = 0;
    while (heap.length) {
      const parent = heap.pop();
      const count = counts.get(parent);
      if (pops === popped.length) {
        popped = grow(popped, pops);
        poppedSizes = grow(poppedSizes, pops);
      }
      popped[pops] = parent;
      poppedSizes[pops++] = sizes.get(parent);
      if (indices.length === start)
        end = Math.max(end, Math.ceil((start + count) / 65536) * 65536);
      if (indices.length + count > end) {
        heap.push(parent, sizes.get(parent));
        // A waiting splat stays if it ranks below the lowest of the pops
        // after it. From the last to wait, which follows the fewest pops.
        let k = pops;
        let low = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        let lowIndex = 0;
        stay = waiting;
        for (let i = waiting - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          for (; k > since[i]; k--) {
            const size = poppedSizes[k - 1];
            if (size < low || (size === low && popped[k - 1] < lowIndex)) {
              low = size;
              lowIndex = popped[k - 1];
            }
          }
          if (
            leafSizes[i] < low ||
            (leafSizes[i] === low && leaves[i] < lowIndex)
          )
            leaves[--stay] = leaves[i];
        }
        stayed = waiting - stay;
        break;
      }
      starts.set(parent, indices.length);
      const firstChild = first.get(parent);
      for (let child = firstChild; child < firstChild + count; child++) {
        indices.push(child);
        add(heap, child);
      }
      if ((pops & 4095) === 0) chunking.update(indices.length);
    }
    // What stays: the heap, then the splats without children.
    const rest = heap.length + stayed;
    const item = (i) =>
      i < heap.length ? heap.index(i) : leaves[stay + i - heap.length];
    if (rest) {
      const min = [
        Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
        Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
        Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
      ];
      const max = [
        Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY,
        Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY,
        Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY,
      ];
      // The centers decide the groups below; keep them for that.
      const centers = new PagedArray(workspace, Float32Array);
      for (let i = 0; i < rest; i++) {
        if ((i & 4095) === 0) chunking.update(indices.length);
        splats.read(item(i), record);
        centers.write(i * 3, record, 3);
        rotation(record, r);
        const sx = Math.max(0.001, SCALE[halfBits(record[7])]) * 1.5;
        const sy = Math.max(0.001, SCALE[halfBits(record[8])]) * 1.5;
        const sz = Math.max(0.001, SCALE[halfBits(record[9])]) * 1.5;
        for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
          const half =
            Math.abs(r[d]) * sx +
            Math.abs(r[3 + d]) * sy +
            Math.abs(r[6 + d]) * sz;
          min[d] = Math.min(min[d], record[d] - half);
          max[d] = Math.max(max[d], record[d] + half);
        }
      }
      const extents = min.map((value, d) => max[d] - value);
      const split = min.map((value, d) => (value + max[d]) * 0.5);
      const axis =
        extents[0] >= extents[1] && extents[0] >= extents[2]
          ? 0
          : extents[1] >= extents[2]
            ? 1
            : 2;
      const binary = extents[axis] >= 3 * Math.min(...extents);
      const groups = Array.from(
        { length: binary ? 2 : 8 },
        () => new IndexArray(workspace),
      );
      for (let i = 0; i < rest; i++) {
        if ((i & 4095) === 0) chunking.update(indices.length);
        const center = centers.read(i * 3, record, 3);
        const group = binary
          ? Number(center[axis] >= split[axis])
          : Number(center[0] >= split[0]) +
            2 * Number(center[1] >= split[1]) +
            4 * Number(center[2] >= split[2]);
        groups[group].push(item(i));
      }
      centers.dispose();
      const sequence = binary
        ? groups[0].length >= groups[1].length
          ? [0, 1]
          : [1, 0]
        : [0, 1, 3, 2, 6, 7, 5, 4];
      for (const index of sequence) {
        if (groups[index].length) batches.push(groups[index]);
        else groups[index].dispose();
      }
    }
    heap.dispose();
    chunking.update(indices.length);
  }
  sizes.dispose();
  if (indices.length !== order.length)
    throw new Error("Incomplete LOD tree ordering");
  chunking.finish();
  const chunked = new Permutation(
    workspace,
    indices,
    order.length,
    "Preparing chunk order",
  );
  splats.records = chunked.apply(
    splats.records,
    16,
    pool,
    false,
    "Reordering chunk splats",
  );
  splats.childCount = chunked.apply(
    counts,
    1,
    pool,
    false,
    "Reordering child counts",
  );
  splats.childStart = chunked.apply(
    starts,
    1,
    pool,
    false,
    "Reordering child offsets",
  );
  chunked.dispose();
  // The SH coefficients are still in node order.
  const shOrder = new Progress("Collecting LOD SH order", indices.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < indices.length; i++) {
    indices.set(i, order.get(indices.get(i)));
    if ((i & 4095) === 0) shOrder.update(i);
  }
  shOrder.finish();
  const nodeOrder = new Permutation(
    workspace,
    indices,
    nodes,
    "Preparing LOD SH order",
  );
  for (let band = 0; band < splats.maxSh; band++)
    splats.sh[band] = nodeOrder.apply(
      splats.sh[band],
      SH_DIMS[band],
      pool,
      false,
      `Reordering LOD SH${band + 1}`,
    );
  nodeOrder.dispose();
  first.dispose();
  splats.length = indices.length;
  indices.dispose();
}
```

### bin/rad/math.js
```
// LOD math adapted from MIT-licensed code. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
const float = new Float32Array(1);
const bits = new Uint32Array(float.buffer);
export const HALF = new Float32Array(65536);
export const SCALE = new Float32Array(65536);
for (let i = 0; i < 65536; i++) {
  const exponent = (i >> 10) & 31;
  const fraction = i & 1023;
  const sign = i & 32768 ? -1 : 1;
  HALF[i] =
    exponent === 31
      ? fraction
        ? Number.NaN
        : sign * Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
      : sign *
        (exponent ? 1 + fraction / 1024 : fraction / 1024) *
        2 ** (exponent ? exponent - 15 : -14);
  SCALE[i] = Math.exp(HALF[i]);
}

export function halfBits(value) {
  float[0] = value;
  const word = bits[0];
  const sign = (word >>> 16) & 32768;
  const exponent = (word >>> 23) & 255;
  let mantissa = word & 0x7fffff;
  if (exponent === 255) return sign | (mantissa ? 0x7e00 : 0x7c00);
  const e = exponent - 112;
  if (e >= 31) return sign | 0x7c00;
  if (e <= 0) {
    if (e < -10) return sign;
    mantissa |= 0x800000;
    const shift = 14 - e;
    return (
      sign |
      ((mantissa + (2 ** (shift - 1) - 1) + ((mantissa >>> shift) & 1)) >>>
        shift)
    );
  }
  return (
    sign | ((e << 10) + ((mantissa + 4095 + ((mantissa >>> 13) & 1)) >>> 13))
  );
}
export function half(value) {
  return HALF[halfBits(value)];
}
export function area(x, y, z) {
  return (
    4 *
    Math.PI *
    (((x * y) ** 1.6075 + (x * z) ** 1.6075 + (y * z) ** 1.6075) / 3) **
      (1 / 1.6075)
  );
}
export function opacityRadius(opacity) {
  return opacity > 1 ? Math.sqrt(1 + Math.E * Math.log(opacity)) : 1;
}

export function rotation(record, output) {
  const x = record[10];
  const y = record[11];
  const z = record[12];
  const w = record[13];
  output[0] = 1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z);
  output[1] = 2 * (x * y + z * w);
  output[2] = 2 * (x * z - y * w);
  output[3] = 2 * (x * y - z * w);
  output[4] = 1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z);
  output[5] = 2 * (y * z + x * w);
  output[6] = 2 * (x * z + y * w);
  output[7] = 2 * (y * z - x * w);
  output[8] = 1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y);
}

export function covariance(record, output, r) {
  rotation(record, r);
  const x = SCALE[halfBits(record[7])] ** 2;
  const y = SCALE[halfBits(record[8])] ** 2;
  const z = SCALE[halfBits(record[9])] ** 2;
  output[0] = r[0] * r[0] * x + r[3] * r[3] * y + r[6] * r[6] * z;
  output[1] = r[1] * r[1] * x + r[4] * r[4] * y + r[7] * r[7] * z;
  output[2] = r[2] * r[2] * x + r[5] * r[5] * y + r[8] * r[8] * z;
  output[3] = r[0] * r[1] * x + r[3] * r[4] * y + r[6] * r[7] * z;
  output[4] = r[0] * r[2] * x + r[3] * r[5] * y + r[6] * r[8] * z;
  output[5] = r[1] * r[2] * x + r[4] * r[5] * y + r[7] * r[8] * z;
}

export function determinant(m) {
  return (
    m[0] * (m[1] * m[2] - m[5] * m[5]) -
    m[3] * (m[3] * m[2] - m[5] * m[4]) +
    m[4] * (m[3] * m[5] - m[1] * m[4])
  );
}

// Jacobi diagonalization of a symmetric covariance. All scratch arrays are
// reused by the caller; merging millions of pairs does not allocate JS objects.
export function eigens(m, matrix, vectors, order) {
  matrix[0] = m[0];
  matrix[4] = m[1];
  matrix[8] = m[2];
  matrix[1] = matrix[3] = m[3];
  matrix[2] = matrix[6] = m[4];
  matrix[5] = matrix[7] = m[5];
  vectors.fill(0);
  vectors[0] = vectors[4] = vectors[8] = 1;
  // A relative tolerance keeps merged orientations independent of scene units.
  const eps = 1e-6 * (Math.abs(m[0]) + Math.abs(m[1]) + Math.abs(m[2]));
  for (let k = 0; k < 32; k++) {
    if (matrix[1] ** 2 + matrix[2] ** 2 + matrix[5] ** 2 <= eps ** 2) break;
    let p = 0;
    let q = 1;
    if (Math.abs(matrix[2]) > Math.abs(matrix[1])) q = 2;
    if (Math.abs(matrix[5]) > Math.abs(matrix[p * 3 + q])) {
      p = 1;
      q = 2;
    }
    const apq = matrix[p * 3 + q];
    if (Math.abs(apq) <= eps) break;
    const app = matrix[p * 3 + p];
    const aqq = matrix[q * 3 + q];
    const tau = (aqq - app) / (2 * apq);
    const t = (tau < 0 ? -1 : 1) / (Math.abs(tau) + Math.sqrt(1 + tau * tau));
    const c = 1 / Math.sqrt(1 + t * t);
    const s = t * c;
    const r = 3 - p - q;
    const arp = matrix[r * 3 + p];
    const arq = matrix[r * 3 + q];
    matrix[p * 3 + p] = app - t * apq;
    matrix[q * 3 + q] = aqq + t * apq;
    matrix[r * 3 + p] = matrix[p * 3 + r] = c * arp - s * arq;
    matrix[r * 3 + q] = matrix[q * 3 + r] = s * arp + c * arq;
    matrix[p * 3 + q] = matrix[q * 3 + p] = 0;
    for (let row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
      const a = vectors[row * 3 + p];
      const b = vectors[row * 3 + q];
      vectors[row * 3 + p] = c * a - s * b;
      vectors[row * 3 + q] = s * a + c * b;
    }
  }
  order[0] = 0;
  order[1] = 1;
  order[2] = 2;
  order.sort((a, b) => matrix[b * 3 + b] - matrix[a * 3 + a]);
}

export function quaternion(r, out) {
  const trace = r[0] + r[4] + r[8];
  if (trace > 0) {
    const s = Math.sqrt(trace + 1) * 2;
    out[10] = (r[5] - r[7]) / s;
    out[11] = (r[6] - r[2]) / s;
    out[12] = (r[1] - r[3]) / s;
    out[13] = s * 0.25;
  } else {
    let i = r[0] > r[4] ? 0 : 1;
    if (r[8] > r[i * 3 + i]) i = 2;
    const j = (i + 1) % 3;
    const k = (i + 2) % 3;
    const s = Math.sqrt(1 + r[i * 3 + i] - r[j * 3 + j] - r[k * 3 + k]) * 2;
    out[10 + i] = s * 0.25;
    out[10 + j] = (r[i * 3 + j] + r[j * 3 + i]) / s;
    out[10 + k] = (r[i * 3 + k] + r[k * 3 + i]) / s;
    out[13] = (r[j * 3 + k] - r[k * 3 + j]) / s;
  }
}
```

### bin/rad/parallel.js
```
import { availableParallelism } from "node:os";
import {
  Worker,
  isMainThread,
  parentPort,
  receiveMessageOnPort,
  workerData,
} from "node:worker_threads";
import { Lookup, NONE } from "./grid.js";
import { HALF, halfBits } from "./math.js";
import {
  INVALID,
  LATER,
  Merger,
  SH_DIMS,
  Similarities,
  filterRecord,
  refresh,
  validRecord,
} from "./splats.js";
import { ArenaViews, Parts, SharedColumn, collect } from "./storage.js";

// A search that the main thread does: a merge failed.
export const MISS = 0xfffffffe;
// The most searches in one round.
export const ROUND = 32768;
// Control words.
const GEN = 0;
const NEXT = 1;
const COUNT = 2;
const DONE = 3;
const VERSION = 4;
const JOB = 5;
const SIZE = 6;
const DIMS = 7;
// The length + 1 of a failed worker's error message in `failure`.
const FAILED = 8;
// A copy's row stride, first source row and target window.
const STRIDE = 10;
const BASE = 11;
const START = 12;
const END = 13;
// The workers that have collected the views of released arenas.
const COLLECTED = 14;
// Jobs.
const SEARCH = 0;
const BLEND = 1;
const COPY = 2;
const CHECK = 3;
const COLLECT = 4;
const TYPES = { Float32Array, Float64Array, Uint16Array, Uint32Array };
const MAX_DIMS = SH_DIMS[SH_DIMS.length - 1];

// Memory each LOD worker thread takes and each encoding worker thread with
// its chunk, with young generations of YOUNG_MB, measured on Linux and macOS;
// what the main thread grows by during the LOD; and the chunks the main
// thread holds for the encoders.
const WORKER_BYTES = 40 * 1024 ** 2;
const ENCODER_BYTES = 52 * 1024 ** 2;
const MAIN_BYTES = 64 * 1024 ** 2;
const CHUNKS_BYTES = 24 * 1024 ** 2;
// What an SH clustering worker thread takes besides its kernel and jobs,
// and the cache that clustering keeps: it reads rows in order.
const CLUSTER_BYTES = 32 * 1024 ** 2;
const STREAM_BYTES = 64 * 1024 ** 2;
export const YOUNG_MB = 8;

// Worker threads with `bytes` each: at most 8, using at most `share` of the
// budget and half the room left besides `extra`, as measured now.
function threads(workspace, bytes, extra, share = 1 / 4) {
  workspace.settle();
  return Math.max(
    0,
    Math.min(
      availableParallelism() - 1,
      8,
      Math.floor((workspace.budget * share) / bytes),
      Math.floor((workspace.room - extra) / 2 / bytes),
    ),
  );
}

// Makes room for the encoding worker threads of `chunks` and returns how
// many there are.
export function encoders(workspace, chunks) {
  const count = Math.min(
    threads(workspace, ENCODER_BYTES, CHUNKS_BYTES),
    chunks - 1,
  );
  workspace.expect(count * ENCODER_BYTES + CHUNKS_BYTES);
  return count;
}

// Makes room for SH clustering worker threads that take `bytes` each besides
// the thread itself, and `extra` bytes on this thread, and returns how many
// there are, at most `jobs`. They only compute, so they may use every other
// core and all the room but a small cache.
export function clusterers(workspace, bytes, extra, jobs) {
  workspace.settle();
  const each = CLUSTER_BYTES + bytes;
  const count = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.min(
      availableParallelism() - 1,
      jobs,
      Math.floor((workspace.room - extra - STREAM_BYTES) / each),
    ),
  );
  workspace.expect(count * each + extra);
  return count;
}

// Ordered request/reply workers for clustering and encoding. Their callers
// schedule the jobs and close the workers; without workers, requests use the
// local handler. Keep workers referenced so exit events can reject requests.
export class WorkerGroup {
  constructor(url, count, workerData, local, name) {
    this.local = local;
    this.workers = Array.from({ length: count }, () => {
      const worker = new Worker(url, {
        workerData,
        resourceLimits: {
          maxOldGenerationSizeMb: 64,
          maxYoungGenerationSizeMb: YOUNG_MB,
        },
      });
      worker.waiting = [];
      worker.on("message", (result) => worker.waiting.shift().resolve(result));
      // A failed worker fails its pending and later requests.
      const fail = (error) => {
        worker.failed ??= error;
        for (const job of worker.waiting.splice(0)) job.reject(worker.failed);
      };
      worker.on("error", fail);
      worker.on("exit", (code) =>
        fail(new Error(`${name} worker exited (${code})`)),
      );
      return worker;
    });
  }

  get threads() {
    return this.workers.length ? this.workers : [undefined];
  }

  request(worker, message, transfer = []) {
    if (!worker) return Promise.resolve(this.local.handle(message));
    if (worker.failed) return Promise.reject(worker.failed);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      worker.waiting.push({ resolve, reject });
      worker.postMessage(message, transfer);
    });
  }

  broadcast(message) {
    return Promise.all(
      this.threads.map((worker) => this.request(worker, message)),
    );
  }

  // Resolves once the workers have stopped and their memory is free.
  close() {
    return Promise.all(this.workers.map((worker) => worker.terminate()));
  }
}

const shared = (Type, size) =>
  new Type(new SharedArrayBuffer(size * Type.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT));

// Whether a state value is unchanged; lists of directories compare by item.
const same = (a, b) =>
  a === b ||
  (Array.isArray(a) &&
    Array.isArray(b) &&
    a.length === b.length &&
    a.every((value, i) => value === b[i]));

// Runs jobs over the pages of shared PagedArrays in worker threads, with the
// main thread taking part: the searches and merges of a round of LOD merges,
// which the main thread then commits in order (see mergeLevels()), SH
// blending, column permutations and the checks of decoded splats. Searches
// read pages that are not cached from their files; the other jobs leave
// what is not cached to the main thread.
export class Pool {
  // Workers pay off for jobs over at least a batch of `splats`.
  constructor(workspace, splats) {
    this.workspace = workspace;
    // Once the LOD grid's entries, 64 bytes a splat, exceed three times the
    // budget, reads of pages dominate: the system serves no more of them
    // with more threads, and fewer threads leave more room for the cache.
    // The threads' share of the budget falls from a quarter in proportion,
    // to an eighth at twice that, below which it saves little.
    const share = Math.max(
      1 / 8,
      Math.min(1 / 4, (0.75 * workspace.budget) / (splats * 64)),
    );
    const count =
      splats < ROUND ? 0 : threads(workspace, WORKER_BYTES, MAIN_BYTES, share);
    this.shared = {
      cancelled: workspace.cancelled,
      control: shared(Int32Array, 16),
      // Bytes that threads read from files, for Workspace.readBytes.
      read: new BigInt64Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(8)),
      failure: shared(Uint8Array, 1024),
      // Each search's splat and its entry.
      nodes: shared(Uint32Array, ROUND),
      entries: shared(Uint32Array, ROUND),
      // Its candidate's entry, NONE or MISS; unless a MISS, the splat's
      // terms and weight and its candidate's node, the merged record and its
      // Similarities terms and the blend weights.
      results: shared(Uint32Array, ROUND),
      // Its score; see Lookup.find().
      metrics: shared(Float64Array, ROUND),
      queries: shared(Float64Array, ROUND * 14),
      partners: shared(Uint32Array, ROUND),
      // The slot of the merged splat's cell if found, else NONE.
      hints: shared(Uint32Array, ROUND),
      records: shared(Float32Array, ROUND * 16),
      terms: shared(Float32Array, ROUND * 13),
      blends: shared(Float64Array, ROUND * 2),
      // SH blending, with the children in `nodes` and `entries` and their
      // weights in `blends`: whether the main thread blends a row, as a
      // child is in the same batch, and the blended rows.
      later: shared(Uint8Array, ROUND),
      blended: shared(Uint16Array, ROUND * MAX_DIMS),
    };
    Object.assign(this, this.shared);
    this.generation = 0;
    // The workspace version and the arrays last sent, and the messages sent.
    this.version = -1;
    this.state = {};
    this.sent = 0;
    this.task = new Task(this.shared);
    workspace.expect(count * WORKER_BYTES + MAIN_BYTES);
    this.workers = Array.from({ length: count }, () => {
      const worker = new Worker(new URL(import.meta.url), {
        workerData: this.shared,
        resourceLimits: { maxYoungGenerationSizeMb: YOUNG_MB },
      });
      worker.unref();
      return worker;
    });
    workspace.collector = () => this.collect();
  }

  // Sends the workers the arrays a job reads, when they changed.
  share(state) {
    if (
      this.workspace.version === this.version &&
      Object.entries(state).every(([key, value]) =>
        same(this.state[key], value),
      )
    )
      return;
    this.version = this.workspace.version;
    Object.assign(this.state, state);
    // All arrays, so that no thread keeps views of released arenas.
    const message = {
      version: ++this.sent,
      arenas: this.workspace.arenas,
      generation: this.workspace.generation,
      ...this.state,
    };
    for (const worker of this.workers) worker.postMessage(message);
    this.task.use(message);
  }

  // Searches and merges for the first `count` nodes and entries, against the
  // grid as it is.
  search(grid, count) {
    const arrays = [grid.entries, grid.slots, grid.gone];
    this.share({
      entries: grid.entries.directory,
      slots: grid.slots.directory,
      gone: grid.gone.directory,
      files: arrays.map((array) => array.files()),
      capacity: grid.capacity,
      step: grid.step,
    });
    this.run(SEARCH, count, 32);
  }

  // Blends the rows of `column` of the first `count` children pairs in
  // `nodes` and `entries` with `blends` into `blended`, except rows marked
  // `later`, and marks them 0 in `results`. Rows that are not cached are left
  // to the main thread.
  blend(column, count, dims) {
    this.share({ column: column.directory });
    Atomics.store(this.control, DIMS, dims);
    this.run(BLEND, count, 512);
  }

  // Copies `count` rows of `source` from row `base` to rows of `output` at
  // their targets + 1 in `nodes` when those lie in [start, end). Marks rows
  // across pages or not cached in `later`, for the main thread.
  copy(source, output, stride, count, base, start, end, words = false) {
    this.share({
      source: source.directory,
      output: output.directory,
      type: words ? "Uint32Array" : source.Type.name,
    });
    const control = this.control;
    Atomics.store(control, STRIDE, stride);
    Atomics.store(control, BASE, base);
    Atomics.store(control, START, start);
    Atomics.store(control, END, end);
    this.run(COPY, count, 1024);
  }

  // Refreshes, checks and optionally crops `count` splats from `base` in
  // place, storing their filter states in `results`; see Splats.retain().
  check(splats, base, count, withinDist) {
    this.share({
      splatRecords: splats.records.directory,
      splatSh: splats.sh
        .slice(0, splats.maxSh)
        .map((column) => column.directory),
      withinDist,
    });
    Atomics.store(this.control, BASE, base);
    this.run(CHECK, count, 1024);
  }

  // Makes the workers drop their views of arenas that the workspace
  // released, and collect them.
  collect() {
    this.share({});
    this.run(COLLECT, 0, 1);
  }

  run(job, count, size) {
    this.workspace.check();
    const gen = ++this.generation;
    const control = this.control;
    Atomics.store(control, JOB, job);
    Atomics.store(control, SIZE, size);
    Atomics.store(control, COUNT, count);
    Atomics.store(control, DONE, 0);
    Atomics.store(control, NEXT, (gen & 0x7fff) << 16);
    Atomics.store(control, VERSION, this.sent);
    Atomics.store(control, COLLECTED, 0);
    Atomics.store(control, GEN, gen);
    Atomics.notify(control, GEN);
    this.task.begin();
    this.task.work(gen);
    for (;;) {
      this.workspace.check();
      const done = Atomics.load(control, DONE);
      if (done >= count) break;
      Atomics.wait(control, DONE, done, 100);
    }
    this.workspace.readBytes += Number(Atomics.exchange(this.read, 0, 0n));
    while (job === COLLECT) {
      this.workspace.check();
      const collected = Atomics.load(control, COLLECTED);
      // A failed worker no longer answers; its error is thrown below.
      if (collected >= this.workers.length || Atomics.load(control, FAILED))
        break;
      Atomics.wait(control, COLLECTED, collected, 100);
    }
    const failed = Atomics.load(control, FAILED);
    if (failed)
      throw new Error(
        `LOD worker failed: ${new TextDecoder().decode(this.failure.slice(0, failed - 1))}`,
      );
  }

  // Stops the workers. Their views and the main thread's would keep arenas
  // that the workspace releases.
  async close() {
    Atomics.store(this.control, GEN, -1);
    Atomics.notify(this.control, GEN);
    await Promise.all(this.workers.map((worker) => worker.terminate()));
    this.task = undefined;
    this.workspace.collector = undefined;
  }
}

// The slot of the cell of merged center `m` that the last find visited: the
// query's cell or the cell of its best, at `b`; NONE if neither.
export function hint(lookup, m, q, b) {
  const inverse = lookup.inverse;
  const x = Math.floor(m[0] * inverse);
  const y = Math.floor(m[1] * inverse);
  const z = Math.floor(m[2] * inverse);
  if (
    x === Math.floor(q[0] * inverse) &&
    y === Math.floor(q[1] * inverse) &&
    z === Math.floor(q[2] * inverse)
  )
    return lookup.home;
  if (
    x === Math.floor(b[0] * inverse) &&
    y === Math.floor(b[1] * inverse) &&
    z === Math.floor(b[2] * inverse)
  )
    return lookup.near;
  return NONE;
}

// One thread's share of the rounds.
class Task {
  constructor(shared) {
    Object.assign(this, shared);
    this.version = -1;
    this.query = new Float64Array(14);
    this.other = new Float64Array(14);
    this.merged = new Float64Array(16);
    this.tuple = new Float64Array(13);
    this.merger = new Merger();
    this.similarities = new Similarities();
    // For the columns of searches: entries, slots and gone.
    this.parts = [Float32Array, Uint32Array, Uint32Array].map(
      (Type) => new Parts(Type),
    );
    this.views = new ArenaViews();
  }

  use(state) {
    this.version = state.version;
    this.views.use(state.arenas, state.generation);
    const views = this.views;
    if (state.entries) {
      const [entries, slots, gone] = [
        [state.entries, Float32Array],
        [state.slots, Uint32Array],
        [state.gone, Uint32Array],
      ].map(
        ([directory, Type], i) =>
          new SharedColumn(
            views,
            directory,
            Type,
            0,
            state.files[i],
            this.parts[i],
          ),
      );
      this.lookup = new Lookup(
        entries,
        slots,
        gone,
        state.capacity,
        state.step,
      );
    }
    if (state.column)
      this.column = new SharedColumn(views, state.column, Uint16Array);
    if (state.splatRecords) {
      this.withinDist = state.withinDist;
      this.splatRecords = new SharedColumn(
        views,
        state.splatRecords,
        Float32Array,
      );
      this.splatSh = state.splatSh.map(
        (directory) => new SharedColumn(views, directory, Uint16Array),
      );
    }
    if (state.source) {
      const Type = TYPES[state.type];
      this.source = new SharedColumn(views, state.source, Type);
      this.output = new SharedColumn(views, state.output, Type);
    }
  }

  // Forgets what searches read from files: pages change between jobs.
  begin() {
    for (const parts of this.parts) parts.reset();
  }

  // Claims chunks of the round `gen` until none are left.
  work(gen) {
    const control = this.control;
    for (;;) {
      if (this.cancelled && Atomics.load(this.cancelled, 0)) return;
      const next = Atomics.load(control, NEXT);
      if (next >>> 16 !== (gen & 0x7fff)) return;
      const start = next & 0xffff;
      if (start >= Atomics.load(control, COUNT)) return;
      const size = Atomics.load(control, SIZE);
      if (Atomics.compareExchange(control, NEXT, next, next + size) !== next)
        continue;
      const count = Atomics.load(control, COUNT);
      const end = Math.min(start + size, count);
      const job = Atomics.load(control, JOB);
      if (job === SEARCH)
        for (let t = start; t < end; t++) this.results[t] = this.search(t);
      else if (job === BLEND)
        this.blend(start, end, Atomics.load(control, DIMS));
      else if (job === COPY) this.copy(start, end);
      else {
        const base = Atomics.load(control, BASE);
        for (let i = start; i < end; i++)
          this.results[i] = this.check(base + i);
      }
      // Before the chunk counts as done, so the main thread finds it.
      let bytes = 0;
      for (const parts of this.parts) {
        bytes += parts.bytesRead;
        parts.bytesRead = 0;
      }
      if (bytes) Atomics.add(this.read, 0, BigInt(bytes));
      if (Atomics.add(control, DONE, end - start) + end - start === count)
        Atomics.notify(control, DONE);
    }
  }

  check(index) {
    const { splatRecords: records, merged: record } = this;
    records.missed = false;
    const values = records.page(index * 16);
    const offset = records.offset(index * 16);
    if (records.missed) return LATER;
    for (let d = 0; d < 16; d++) record[d] = values[offset + d];
    refresh(record);
    values[offset + 14] = record[14];
    values[offset + 15] = record[15];
    if (!validRecord(record)) return INVALID;
    for (let band = 0; band < this.splatSh.length; band++) {
      const dims = SH_DIMS[band];
      const column = this.splatSh[band];
      column.missed = false;
      const row = column.page(index * dims);
      const at = column.offset(index * dims);
      if (column.missed || ((index * dims) & column.mask) > column.items - dims)
        return LATER;
      for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++)
        if (!Number.isFinite(HALF[row[at + d]])) return INVALID;
    }
    return filterRecord(record, this.withinDist);
  }

  copy(from, to) {
    const { source, output, nodes, later, control } = this;
    const stride = Atomics.load(control, STRIDE);
    const base = Atomics.load(control, BASE);
    const start = Atomics.load(control, START);
    const end = Atomics.load(control, END);
    const last = source.items - stride;
    for (let i = from; i < to; i++) {
      later[i] = 0;
      const target = nodes[i] - 1;
      if (target < start || target >= end) continue;
      const s = (base + i) * stride;
      const t = target * stride;
      source.missed = false;
      output.missed = false;
      const values = source.page(s);
      const offset = source.offset(s);
      const out = output.page(t);
      const at = output.offset(t);
      if (
        source.missed ||
        output.missed ||
        (s & source.mask) > last ||
        (t & output.mask) > last
      ) {
        later[i] = 1;
        continue;
      }
      for (let d = 0; d < stride; d++) out[at + d] = values[offset + d];
    }
  }

  blend(start, end, dims) {
    const { column, nodes, entries, blends, later, blended, results } = this;
    const last = column.items - dims;
    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
      if (later[i]) continue;
      const a = nodes[i] * dims;
      const b = entries[i] * dims;
      column.missed = false;
      const left = column.page(a);
      const l = column.offset(a);
      const right = column.page(b);
      const r = column.offset(b);
      // A row across two pages is left to the main thread.
      if (
        column.missed ||
        (a & column.mask) > last ||
        (b & column.mask) > last
      ) {
        results[i] = MISS;
        continue;
      }
      results[i] = 0;
      const w = blends[i * 2];
      const v = blends[i * 2 + 1];
      for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++)
        blended[i * dims + d] = halfBits(
          HALF[left[l + d]] * w + HALF[right[r + d]] * v,
        );
    }
  }

  search(t) {
    const { lookup, query, other, merged } = this;
    lookup.read(this.entries[t], query);
    const best = lookup.find(query, this.nodes[t]);
    this.metrics[t] = lookup.metric;
    this.queries.set(query, t * 14);
    if (best === NONE) return best;
    this.partners[t] = lookup.read(best, other);
    try {
      this.merger.run(query, other, query[13], other[13], merged);
    } catch {
      // The main thread merges again and reports the error.
      return MISS;
    }
    this.records.set(merged, t * 16);
    this.hints[t] = hint(lookup, merged, query, other);
    this.terms.set(this.similarities.terms(merged, this.tuple), t * 13);
    this.blends[t * 2] = this.merger.w;
    this.blends[t * 2 + 1] = this.merger.v;
    return best;
  }
}

if (!isMainThread && workerData?.control) {
  const task = new Task(workerData);
  const control = task.control;
  for (let seen = 0; ; ) {
    Atomics.wait(control, GEN, seen);
    const gen = Atomics.load(control, GEN);
    if (gen < 0) break;
    seen = gen;
    try {
      const version = Atomics.load(control, VERSION);
      while (task.version < version) {
        const received = receiveMessageOnPort(parentPort);
        if (received) task.use(received.message);
      }
      task.begin();
      if (Atomics.load(control, JOB) === COLLECT) {
        collect();
        Atomics.add(control, COLLECTED, 1);
        Atomics.notify(control, COLLECTED);
        continue;
      }
      task.work(gen);
    } catch (error) {
      // Report the error and release the round, so the main thread throws it.
      // The thread ends, and its views with it, so it counts as collected.
      const message = new TextEncoder().encode(String(error?.stack ?? error));
      const length = Math.min(message.length, task.failure.length - 1);
      task.failure.set(message.subarray(0, length));
      Atomics.store(control, FAILED, length + 1);
      Atomics.store(control, DONE, Atomics.load(control, COUNT));
      Atomics.notify(control, DONE);
      Atomics.add(control, COLLECTED, 1);
      Atomics.notify(control, COLLECTED);
      break;
    }
  }
}
```

### bin/rad/progress.js
```
import { parentPort } from "node:worker_threads";

let inline = false;

// Call update at batch boundaries, not for every splat. A completed stage is
// the only place that reports 100%; rounding cannot finish a stage early.
export class Progress {
  // Keep synchronous setup steps on the same line as the stage that follows.
  static inline(run) {
    inline = true;
    try {
      return run();
    } finally {
      inline = false;
    }
  }

  constructor(label, total, detail = "") {
    this.label = label;
    this.total = total;
    this.started = performance.now();
    this.updated = this.started;
    this.print(0, false, detail);
  }

  update(completed, detail = "") {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - this.updated < 500) return;
    this.updated = now;
    const percent = this.total
      ? Math.min(99.9, Math.floor((completed * 1000) / this.total) / 10)
      : 0;
    this.print(percent, false, detail);
  }

  finish(detail = "") {
    this.print(100, true, detail);
  }

  print(percent, done, detail) {
    const seconds = ((performance.now() - this.started) / 1000).toFixed(1);
    const line = `${this.label}: ${percent.toFixed(1)}%${detail ? `, ${detail}` : ""} (${seconds}s)`;
    if (parentPort)
      parentPort.postMessage({
        method: "progress",
        args: [line, done && !inline],
      });
    else console.log(line);
  }
}
```
