```
// RAD v1 encoding adapted from MIT-licensed code. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import {
  closeSync,
  fsyncSync,
  lstatSync,
  openSync,
  readdirSync,
  renameSync,
  statSync,
} from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { isMainThread, parentPort, workerData } from "node:worker_threads";
import { deflateRawSync } from "node:zlib";
import { HALF, half, halfBits, opacityRadius } from "./math.js";
import { WorkerGroup, encoders } from "./parallel.js";
import { Progress } from "./progress.js";
import { SH_DIMS } from "./splats.js";
import { readAll, removePath, writeAll } from "./storage.js";

const CHUNK = 65536;
// Fixed s8 range with SPZ's 1/128 SH step; -1 clips to -127/128.
const SH_MAX = 127 / 128;
function encodeSh(value) {
  const magnitude = Math.min(127, Math.round(Math.abs(value) * 128));
  return (value < 0 ? -magnitude : magnitude) & 255;
}
const SH_CODES = Uint8Array.from(HALF, encodeSh);
function header(magic, meta) {
  const json = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(meta));
  const result = Buffer.alloc(8 + Math.ceil(json.length / 8) * 8);
  result.write(magic);
  result.writeUInt32LE(json.length, 4);
  json.copy(result, 8);
  return result;
}
function exists(file) {
  try {
    lstatSync(file);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}
function chunkStem(output) {
  const stem = path.basename(output, path.extname(output));
  // Keep the on-disk name usable as a relative URL and a resolveFile key.
  // Escape '=' too so distinct stems cannot produce the same chunk names.
  return Array.from(stem, (char) =>
    char <= " " || "\\%#?:=".includes(char)
      ? encodeURIComponent(char).replace("%", "=")
      : char,
  ).join("");
}
export function checkOutput(output, chunked) {
  if (path.extname(output).toLowerCase() !== ".rad")
    throw new Error("Output must have a .rad extension");
  if (exists(output)) throw new Error(`Output already exists: ${output}`);
  if (!statSync(path.dirname(output)).isDirectory())
    throw new Error("Output parent is not a directory");
  if (chunked) {
    const prefix = `${chunkStem(output)}-`;
    for (const name of readdirSync(path.dirname(output))) {
      if (
        name.startsWith(prefix) &&
        /^\d+\.radc$/.test(name.slice(prefix.length))
      )
        throw new Error(`Output chunk already exists: ${name}`);
    }
  }
}
class Histogram {
  constructor() {
    this.counts = new Float64Array(65536);
    this.count = 0;
  }
  // Adds the counts of a Histogram, also one copied from a worker.
  merge(other) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 65536; i++) this.counts[i] += other.counts[i];
    this.count += other.count;
  }
  add(bits) {
    this.counts[bits & 32768 ? bits ^ 65535 : bits ^ 32768]++;
    this.count++;
  }
  percentile(fraction) {
    let rank = Math.min(
      this.count - 1,
      Math.round(Math.fround(Math.fround(this.count) * Math.fround(fraction))),
    );
    for (let i = 0; i < 65536; i++) {
      if (rank < this.counts[i]) return HALF[i & 32768 ? i ^ 32768 : i ^ 65535];
      rank -= this.counts[i];
    }
    throw new Error("Empty encoding histogram");
  }
}
function alpha(value) {
  return value > 1
    ? half(Math.min(2, 1 + 0.25 * (opacityRadius(value) - 1)))
    : value;
}
// The base attributes that determine the encoding ranges.
class Counts {
  constructor() {
    this.colors = new Histogram();
    this.scales = new Histogram();
    this.alphaF16 = false;
  }
  add(records) {
    for (let offset = 0; offset < records.length; offset += 16) {
      this.alphaF16 ||= alpha(records[offset + 3]) > 1;
      for (let d = 4; d <= 6; d++)
        this.colors.add(halfBits(records[offset + d]));
      const a = records[offset + 7];
      const b = records[offset + 8];
      const c = records[offset + 9];
      this.scales.add(
        halfBits(Math.max(Math.min(a, b), Math.min(Math.max(a, b), c))),
      );
      this.scales.add(halfBits(Math.max(a, b, c)));
    }
  }
  merge(other) {
    this.colors.merge(other.colors);
    this.scales.merge(other.scales);
    this.alphaF16 ||= other.alphaF16;
  }
}

function encoding(counts) {
  const { colors, scales } = counts;
  const rgbMin = Math.min(0, colors.percentile(0.01));
  const rgbMax = Math.max(1, colors.percentile(0.99));
  const lnScaleMin = Math.min(
    -12,
    Math.max(Math.log(1e-30), scales.percentile(0.01)),
  );
  const lnScaleMax = Math.max(9, scales.percentile(0.99));
  return {
    alphaF16: counts.alphaF16,
    rgbF16: rgbMin < -1 || rgbMax > 2,
    scaleF16: lnScaleMax - lnScaleMin > 25,
    meta: {
      rgbMin,
      rgbMax,
      lnScaleMin,
      lnScaleMax,
      sh1Max: SH_MAX,
      sh2Max: SH_MAX,
      sh3Max: SH_MAX,
      lodOpacity: true,
    },
  };
}
const unorm = (value, min, max) =>
  Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(255, ((value - min) / (max - min)) * 255)));

// The columns encodeChunk() reads. With a codebook, labels replace the SH.
function gather(splats, base, count, codebook) {
  return {
    base,
    count,
    maxSh: splats.maxSh,
    records: splats.records.read(base * 16, new Float32Array(count * 16)),
    sh: codebook
      ? []
      : splats.sh
          .slice(0, splats.maxSh)
          .map((column, band) =>
            column.read(
              base * SH_DIMS[band],
              new Uint16Array(count * SH_DIMS[band]),
            ),
          ),
    ...(codebook && {
      labels: codebook.labels.read(base, new Uint16Array(count)),
    }),
    counts: splats.childCount.read(base, new Uint32Array(count)),
    starts: splats.childStart.read(base, new Float64Array(count)),
  };
}

// The codebook's entries as s8 codes of each band, coefficient by coefficient.
function encodeCodes(codebook, maxSh) {
  const { count, dims, codes } = codebook;
  const bands = [];
  let offset = 0;
  for (let band = 0; band < maxSh; band++) {
    const size = SH_DIMS[band];
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(count * size);
    for (let d = 0; d < size; d++)
      for (let c = 0; c < count; c++)
        bytes[d * count + c] = encodeSh(codes[c * dims + offset + d]);
    bands.push(bytes);
    offset += size;
  }
  return bands;
}

// Raw property bytes, reused: each property is compressed before the next.
const scratch = [Buffer.alloc(0), Buffer.alloc(0)];
function raw(size, slot = 0) {
  if (scratch[slot].length < size) scratch[slot] = Buffer.allocUnsafe(size);
  return scratch[slot].subarray(0, size);
}

function encodeChunk(chunk, encoding) {
  const { base, count, records } = chunk;
  const properties = [];
  const payloads = [];
  let payloadBytes = 0;
  // Compresses a property's bytes and appends them, padded to 8 bytes.
  const property = (name, codec, data, range) => {
    const bytes = deflateRawSync(data, { level: 6 });
    const padding = Buffer.alloc((8 - (bytes.length % 8)) % 8);
    properties.push({
      property: name,
      encoding: codec,
      compression: "gz",
      ...(range && { min: range[0], max: range[1] }),
      offset: payloadBytes,
      bytes: bytes.length,
    });
    payloads.push(bytes, padding);
    payloadBytes += bytes.length + padding.length;
  };
  const input = new Uint8Array(records.buffer);
  let bytes = raw(count * 12);
  for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++)
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++)
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++)
        bytes[(b * 3 + d) * count + i] = input[i * 64 + d * 4 + b];
  property("center", "f32_lebytes", bytes);
  bytes = raw(count * (encoding.alphaF16 ? 2 : 1));
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const value = alpha(records[i * 16 + 3]);
    if (encoding.alphaF16) bytes.writeUInt16LE(halfBits(value), i * 2);
    else bytes[i] = unorm(value, 0, 2);
  }
  property(
    "alpha",
    encoding.alphaF16 ? "f16" : "r8",
    bytes,
    encoding.alphaF16 ? undefined : [0, 2],
  );
  bytes = raw(count * 3 * (encoding.rgbF16 ? 2 : 1));
  for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
    let last = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const value = records[i * 16 + 4 + d];
      const offset = d * count + i;
      if (encoding.rgbF16) bytes.writeUInt16LE(halfBits(value), offset * 2);
      else {
        const code = unorm(value, encoding.meta.rgbMin, encoding.meta.rgbMax);
        bytes[offset] = (code - last) & 255;
        last = code;
      }
    }
  }
  property(
    "rgb",
    encoding.rgbF16 ? "f16" : "r8_delta",
    bytes,
    encoding.rgbF16 ? undefined : [encoding.meta.rgbMin, encoding.meta.rgbMax],
  );
  bytes = raw(count * 3 * (encoding.scaleF16 ? 2 : 1));
  for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++)
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const value = records[i * 16 + 7 + d];
      const offset = d * count + i;
      if (encoding.scaleF16) bytes.writeUInt16LE(halfBits(value), offset * 2);
      else
        bytes[offset] =
          value <= -30
            ? 0
            : 1 +
              Math.round(
                Math.max(
                  0,
                  Math.min(
                    254,
                    ((value - encoding.meta.lnScaleMin) /
                      (encoding.meta.lnScaleMax - encoding.meta.lnScaleMin)) *
                      254,
                  ),
                ),
              );
    }
  property(
    "scales",
    encoding.scaleF16 ? "ln_f16" : "ln_0r8",
    bytes,
    encoding.scaleF16
      ? undefined
      : [encoding.meta.lnScaleMin, encoding.meta.lnScaleMax],
  );
  bytes = raw(count * 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const offset = i * 16;
    const sign = records[offset + 13] < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    const theta =
      2 * Math.acos(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, records[offset + 13] * sign)));
    const s = Math.sin(theta * 0.5);
    let x = Math.abs(s) < 1e-6 ? 1 : (records[offset + 10] * sign) / s;
    let y = Math.abs(s) < 1e-6 ? 0 : (records[offset + 11] * sign) / s;
    const z = Math.abs(s) < 1e-6 ? 0 : (records[offset + 12] * sign) / s;
    const sum = Math.abs(x) + Math.abs(y) + Math.abs(z);
    x /= sum;
    y /= sum;
    if (z < 0) {
      const old = x;
      x = (1 - Math.abs(y)) * (x >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
      y = (1 - Math.abs(old)) * (y >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }
    bytes[i * 3] = unorm(x, -1, 1);
    bytes[i * 3 + 1] = unorm(y, -1, 1);
    bytes[i * 3 + 2] = unorm(theta, 0, Math.PI);
  }
  property("orientation", "oct88r8", bytes);
  if (chunk.labels) {
    // The first chunk holds the codebook for all.
    for (let band = 0; chunk.codes && band < chunk.maxSh; band++)
      property(`sh${band + 1}_code`, "s8", chunk.codes[band], [
        -SH_MAX,
        SH_MAX,
      ]);
    bytes = raw(count * 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) bytes.writeUInt16LE(chunk.labels[i], i * 2);
    property("sh_label", "u16", bytes);
  }
  for (let band = 0; band < chunk.sh.length; band++) {
    const dims = SH_DIMS[band];
    const values = chunk.sh[band];
    bytes = raw(count * dims);
    for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++)
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++)
        bytes[d * count + i] = SH_CODES[values[i * dims + d]];
    property(`sh${band + 1}`, "s8", bytes, [-SH_MAX, SH_MAX]);
  }
  const counts = raw(count * 2);
  const starts = raw(count * 4, 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const children = chunk.counts[i];
    counts.writeUInt16LE(children, i * 2);
    starts.writeUInt32LE(children ? chunk.starts[i] : 0, i * 4);
  }
  property("child_count", "u16", counts);
  property("child_start", "u32", starts);
  const meta = header("RADC", {
    version: 1,
    base,
    count,
    maxSh: chunk.maxSh,
    lodTree: true,
    splatEncoding: encoding.meta,
    payloadBytes,
    properties,
  });
  const size = Buffer.alloc(8);
  size.writeBigUInt64LE(BigInt(payloadBytes));
  return Buffer.concat([meta, size, ...payloads]);
}

// Counts and encodes chunks; in workers, each answers in order.
class Coder {
  constructor() {
    this.counts = new Counts();
    this.format = undefined;
  }
  handle({ type, records, chunk, format }) {
    if (type === "count") this.counts.add(records);
    else if (type === "counts") return this.counts;
    else if (type === "format") this.format = format;
    else return encodeChunk(chunk, this.format);
    return true;
  }
}

// Spreads counting and encoding over worker threads.
class Encoder extends WorkerGroup {
  // Encodes `chunks` with workers when there is more than one and the
  // workspace has room for them.
  constructor(workspace, chunks) {
    const count = encoders(workspace, chunks);
    super(
      new URL(import.meta.url),
      count,
      { coder: true },
      count ? undefined : new Coder(),
      "Encoding",
    );
    this.next = 0;
  }
  get size() {
    return this.workers.length;
  }
  // Sends the next job to the next worker.
  send(message, transfer) {
    return this.request(
      this.workers[this.next++ % this.workers.length],
      message,
      transfer,
    );
  }
  count(records) {
    return this.send({ type: "count", records }, [records.buffer]);
  }
  async counts() {
    const counts = new Counts();
    for (const result of await this.broadcast({ type: "counts" }))
      counts.merge(result);
    return counts;
  }
  use(format) {
    return this.broadcast({ type: "format", format });
  }
  async encode(chunk) {
    const bytes = await this.send({ type: "encode", chunk }, [
      chunk.records.buffer,
      ...chunk.sh.map((values) => values.buffer),
      ...(chunk.labels ? [chunk.labels.buffer] : []),
      ...(chunk.codes ?? []).map((values) => values.buffer),
      chunk.counts.buffer,
      chunk.starts.buffer,
    ]);
    return Buffer.from(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.length);
  }
}

if (!isMainThread && workerData?.coder) {
  const coder = new Coder();
  parentPort.on("message", (message) => {
    const result = coder.handle(message);
    // The chunk's buffers would otherwise pile up to tens of MiB before the
    // collector frees them.
    gc();
    // A chunk with its own memory moves to the main thread without a copy.
    const own =
      result instanceof Uint8Array &&
      result.byteOffset === 0 &&
      result.byteLength === result.buffer.byteLength;
    parentPort.postMessage(result, own ? [result.buffer] : []);
  });
}

// With a codebook from clusterSh(), splats store SH as its labels.
export async function writeRad(splats, output, chunked, lodBase, codebook) {
  const chunks = [];
  const stem = chunkStem(output);
  const spool = chunked ? undefined : splats.workspace.file();
  // Write every file completely before publishing chunks, then the header.
  // Track published names too, so cancellation rolls back this conversion.
  const staged = [];
  const created = [];
  const stage = (file, write) => {
    splats.workspace.check();
    const temporary = path.join(
      path.dirname(file),
      `.${path.basename(file)}.${process.pid}.${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}.tmp`,
    );
    const fd = openSync(temporary, "wx");
    staged.push({ temporary, file });
    try {
      write(fd);
      fsyncSync(fd);
    } catch (error) {
      try {
        closeSync(fd);
      } catch {}
      throw error;
    }
    closeSync(fd);
  };
  let total = 0;
  let progress;
  const store = (bytes) => {
    if (chunked) {
      const filename = `${stem}-${chunks.length}.radc`;
      stage(path.join(path.dirname(output), filename), (fd) =>
        writeAll(fd, bytes, 0),
      );
      chunks.push({ offset: 0, bytes: bytes.length, filename });
    } else {
      writeAll(spool, bytes, total);
      chunks.push({ offset: total, bytes: bytes.length });
    }
    total += bytes.length;
    progress.update(chunks.length);
  };
  // Gather the next chunks while workers encode earlier ones; store them in
  // order. A chunk's failure is thrown when its turn comes, not as an
  // unhandled rejection while an earlier chunk is awaited.
  const pending = [];
  const encoder = new Encoder(
    splats.workspace,
    Math.ceil(splats.length / CHUNK),
  );
  try {
    // Count the encoding ranges in a first pass.
    const chunkCount = Math.ceil(splats.length / CHUNK);
    progress = new Progress("Analyzing RAD encoding", chunkCount);
    let countedChunks = 0;
    for (let base = 0; base < splats.length; base += CHUNK) {
      splats.workspace.check();
      const count = Math.min(CHUNK, splats.length - base);
      const records = splats.records.read(
        base * 16,
        new Float32Array(count * 16),
      );
      const counted = encoder
        .count(records)
        .then(() => progress.update(++countedChunks));
      counted.catch(() => {});
      pending.push(counted);
      if (pending.length > encoder.size + 1) await pending.shift();
    }
    while (pending.length) await pending.shift();
    const format = encoding(await encoder.counts());
    await encoder.use(format);
    progress.finish();
    progress = new Progress("Encoding RAD chunks", chunkCount);
    for (let base = 0; base < splats.length; base += CHUNK) {
      splats.workspace.check();
      const chunk = gather(
        splats,
        base,
        Math.min(CHUNK, splats.length - base),
        codebook,
      );
      if (codebook && base === 0)
        chunk.codes = encodeCodes(codebook, splats.maxSh);
      const bytes = encoder.encode(chunk);
      bytes.catch(() => {});
      pending.push(bytes);
      if (pending.length > encoder.size + 1) store(await pending.shift());
    }
    while (pending.length) store(await pending.shift());
    progress.finish(`${chunks.length} chunks`);
    const meta = header("RAD0", {
      version: 1,
      type: "gsplat",
      count: splats.length,
      maxSh: splats.maxSh,
      lodTree: true,
      chunkSize: CHUNK,
      allChunkBytes: total,
      chunks,
      splatEncoding: format.meta,
      ...(codebook && { shCodeCount: codebook.count }),
      comment: `Gaussian Splat Lite quality LOD (base ${lodBase})`,
    });
    const writing = new Progress(
      "Writing RAD file",
      meta.length + (spool === undefined ? 0 : total),
    );
    stage(output, (fd) => {
      writeAll(fd, meta, 0);
      if (spool !== undefined) {
        const buffer = Buffer.allocUnsafe(1024 * 1024);
        for (let offset = 0; offset < total; offset += buffer.length) {
          splats.workspace.check();
          const bytes = buffer.subarray(
            0,
            Math.min(buffer.length, total - offset),
          );
          readAll(spool, bytes, offset);
          writeAll(fd, bytes, meta.length + offset);
          writing.update(meta.length + offset + bytes.length);
        }
      }
    });
    writing.finish();
    const publishing = new Progress("Publishing RAD files", staged.length);
    for (const { temporary, file } of staged) {
      splats.workspace.check();
      // rename can replace an existing file, so reserve the name exclusively.
      const fd = openSync(file, "wx");
      created.push(file);
      closeSync(fd);
      renameSync(temporary, file);
      publishing.update(created.length);
    }
    splats.workspace.check();
    publishing.finish();
    return meta.length + total;
  } catch (error) {
    await Promise.allSettled(pending);
    for (const { temporary } of staged) removePath(temporary);
    for (const file of created) removePath(file);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    await encoder.close();
  }
}
```

### bin/rad/splats.js
```
// LOD storage and merging adapted from MIT-licensed code. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
import {
  HALF,
  SCALE,
  area,
  covariance,
  determinant,
  eigens,
  half,
  halfBits,
  opacityRadius,
  quaternion,
} from "./math.js";
import { Progress } from "./progress.js";
import { IndexArray, PagedArray, Permutation } from "./storage.js";

export const SH_DIMS = [9, 15, 21];

// What retain() finds a splat to be.
export const KEEP = 0;
export const INVALID = 1;
export const EMPTY = 2;
export const CROPPED = 3;
// A worker found a page that is not cached.
export const LATER = 4;

// Sets a record's feature size and area from its scales and opacity.
export function refresh(record) {
  const x = SCALE[halfBits(record[7])];
  const y = SCALE[halfBits(record[8])];
  const z = SCALE[halfBits(record[9])];
  record[14] = Math.fround(2 * Math.max(x, y, z) * opacityRadius(record[3]));
  record[15] = Math.fround(area(x, y, z));
}

// Whether a record has no negative opacity and no NaN or infinite values but
// zero scales (log scale -Infinity).
export function validRecord(record) {
  if (record[3] < 0) return false;
  for (let d = 0; d < 16; d++)
    if (
      !Number.isFinite(record[d]) &&
      !(d >= 7 && d <= 9 && record[d] === Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)
    )
      return false;
  return true;
}

// Classifies a valid record after refresh(), including optional cropping.
export function filterRecord(record, withinDist) {
  if (record[3] <= 0 || record[14] <= 0) return EMPTY;
  if (!withinDist) return KEEP;
  const [x, y, z, radius] = withinDist;
  return Math.hypot(record[0] - x, record[1] - y, record[2] - z) > radius
    ? CROPPED
    : KEEP;
}

export class Splats {
  constructor(workspace, maxSh) {
    this.workspace = workspace;
    this.maxSh = maxSh;
    this.inputSh = 0;
    this.length = 0;
    this.invalid = 0;
    this.cropped = 0;
    this.records = new PagedArray(workspace, Float32Array);
    this.sh = SH_DIMS.map(() => new PagedArray(workspace, Uint16Array));
    // The two children of the i-th merged splat are entries 2i and 2i + 1 of
    // `children`. Once buildLod() has laid out the tree, a splat's children
    // are the childCount consecutive rows from row childStart.
    this.childStart = new PagedArray(workspace, Float64Array);
    this.childCount = new IndexArray(workspace);
    this.children = new IndexArray(workspace);
    // Each splat's merge weight, area × opacity, which merge() reads instead
    // of two records.
    this.weight = new PagedArray(workspace, Float64Array);
    // The two child weights of each merged splat, for mergeSh().
    this.blend = new PagedArray(workspace, Float64Array);
    this.merged = new Float64Array(16);
    this.bits = new Uint16Array(0);
    this.merger = new Merger();
    this.shLeft = new Uint16Array(21);
    this.shRight = new Uint16Array(21);
  }

  receive(name, base, values) {
    if (name === "init") {
      if (base > 0x80000000)
        throw new Error("Input exceeds LOD u32 index limit");
      this.length = base;
      this.records.length = base * 16;
      this.inputSh = values[0];
      this.maxSh = Math.min(this.maxSh, this.inputSh, 3);
      for (let band = 0; band < this.maxSh; band++)
        this.sh[band].length = base * SH_DIMS[band];
      return;
    }
    if (!values.length) return;
    // `bits` is reused, so reading leaves no freed buffers behind.
    if (name.startsWith("sh")) {
      const band = Number(name[2]) - 1;
      if (band >= this.maxSh) return;
      if (this.bits.length < values.length)
        this.bits = new Uint16Array(values.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++)
        this.bits[i] = halfBits(values[i]);
      this.sh[band].write(base * SH_DIMS[band], this.bits, values.length);
      return;
    }
    const [field, dims] = {
      center: [0, 3],
      opacity: [3, 1],
      rgb: [4, 3],
      scale: [7, 3],
      lnScale: [7, 3],
      quat: [10, 4],
    }[name];
    for (let i = 0; i < values.length / dims; i++) {
      const index = (base + i) * 16 + field;
      const page = this.records.page(index, true);
      const offset = index & this.records.mask;
      for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++) {
        const value =
          name === "scale"
            ? Math.log(values[i * dims + d])
            : values[i * dims + d];
        page[offset + d] = field === 0 ? value : half(value);
      }
    }
  }

  read(index, output) {
    return this.records.read(index * 16, output, 16);
  }
  feature(index) {
    return this.records.get(index * 16 + 14);
  }

  // Skips empty splats and counts invalid ones in `invalid`: NaN or infinite
  // values, including a zero rotation, which the decoder normalizes to NaN.
  // Optionally keeps only centers within [x, y, z, radius], counting the
  // otherwise usable splats outside this sphere in `cropped`.
  // Workers refresh, check and crop blocks of splats; the main thread
  // checks those they leave, and moves kept splats after skipped ones.
  retain(pool, withinDist) {
    const progress = new Progress("Filtering splats", this.length);
    const { results } = pool;
    const block = results.length;
    const record = new Float64Array(16);
    const rows = SH_DIMS.map((dims) => new Uint16Array(dims));
    const columns = [
      [this.records.share(), 16],
      ...this.sh
        .slice(0, this.maxSh)
        .map((column, band) => [column.share(), SH_DIMS[band]]),
    ];
    let count = 0;
    this.invalid = 0;
    this.cropped = 0;
    for (let base = 0; base < this.length; base += block) {
      const size = Math.min(block, this.length - base);
      for (const [column, stride] of columns)
        column.load(
          base * stride,
          (base + size) * stride,
          column === this.records,
        );
      pool.check(this, base, size, withinDist);
      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        const index = base + i;
        let state = results[i];
        const later = state === LATER;
        if (later) {
          this.read(index, record);
          refresh(record);
          state = !this.valid(index, record, rows)
            ? INVALID
            : filterRecord(record, withinDist);
        }
        if (state === INVALID) this.invalid++;
        if (state === CROPPED) this.cropped++;
        if (state !== KEEP) continue;
        if (count !== index || later) {
          if (!later) this.read(index, record);
          this.records.write(count * 16, record);
        }
        if (count !== index) {
          for (let band = 0; band < this.maxSh; band++) {
            const dims = SH_DIMS[band];
            this.sh[band].read(index * dims, rows[band]);
            this.sh[band].write(count * dims, rows[band]);
          }
        }
        count++;
      }
      progress.update(base + size);
    }
    this.length = count;
    this.records.length = count * 16;
    for (let band = 0; band < this.maxSh; band++)
      this.sh[band].length = count * SH_DIMS[band];
    progress.finish(`${count} usable splats`);
  }
  // Also reads the splat's SH coefficients into `rows`.
  valid(index, record, rows) {
    if (!validRecord(record)) return false;
    for (let band = 0; band < this.maxSh; band++) {
      const row = rows[band];
      this.sh[band].read(index * row.length, row);
      for (const bits of row) if (!Number.isFinite(HALF[bits])) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  // `ca` and `cb` are the Similarities terms of splats `a` and `b`, each
  // followed by its weight.
  merge(a, b, ca, cb) {
    const merger = this.merger;
    merger.run(ca, cb, ca[13], cb[13], this.merged);
    return this.append(a, b, this.merged, merger.w, merger.v);
  }

  // Adds the merge `out` of splats `a` and `b`, blended with weights w and v.
  append(a, b, out, w, v) {
    const index = this.length++;
    this.records.write(index * 16, out);
    this.weight.set(index, out[15] * out[3]);
    this.children.push(a);
    this.children.push(b);
    // SH coefficients do not affect merging; mergeSh() blends them later.
    if (this.maxSh) {
      this.blend.push(w);
      this.blend.push(v);
    }
    return index;
  }

  // Blends the SH coefficients of the splats merge() created from `initial`
  // on, in creation order, so children are done before their parents. Going
  // band by band keeps the random reads of children within one column.
  // Workers blend batches of splats whose children precede the batch; the
  // rest wait for their children in the batch.
  mergeSh(initial, pool) {
    const { nodes, entries, later, blends, blended, results } = pool;
    // Splats per batch.
    const size = later.length;
    const rows = [this.shLeft, this.shRight];
    for (let band = 0; band < this.maxSh; band++) {
      const progress = new Progress(
        `Blending SH${band + 1}`,
        this.length - initial,
      );
      const dims = SH_DIMS[band];
      const column = this.sh[band].share();
      for (let start = initial; start < this.length; start += size) {
        const count = Math.min(size, this.length - start);
        // Load the pages of the children's rows for the workers. Consecutive
        // splats' children often share pages; a page evicted meanwhile is a
        // miss that the main thread blends.
        let left = -1;
        let right = -1;
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const a = this.children.get((start + i - initial) * 2);
          const b = this.children.get((start + i - initial) * 2 + 1);
          nodes[i] = a;
          entries[i] = b;
          blends[i * 2] = this.blend.get((start + i - initial) * 2);
          blends[i * 2 + 1] = this.blend.get((start + i - initial) * 2 + 1);
          later[i] = Number(a >= start || b >= start);
          if (later[i]) continue;
          if (Math.floor((a * dims) / column.items) !== left) {
            left = Math.floor((a * dims) / column.items);
            column.page(a * dims);
          }
          if (Math.floor((b * dims) / column.items) !== right) {
            right = Math.floor((b * dims) / column.items);
            column.page(b * dims);
          }
        }
        pool.blend(column, count, dims);
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          // A worker blended rows it marked 0.
          if (!later[i] && results[i] === 0) continue;
          for (let c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            const child = c ? entries[i] : nodes[i];
            if (child < start) column.read(child * dims, rows[c], dims);
            else
              for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++)
                rows[c][d] = blended[(child - start) * dims + d];
          }
          const w = blends[i * 2];
          const v = blends[i * 2 + 1];
          for (let d = 0; d < dims; d++)
            blended[i * dims + d] = halfBits(
              HALF[this.shLeft[d]] * w + HALF[this.shRight[d]] * v,
            );
        }
        column.write(start * dims, blended, count * dims);
        progress.update(start + count - initial);
      }
      progress.finish();
    }
    this.blend.dispose();
  }

  // Moves row indices[i] of the records and SH to row i.
  reorder(indices, pool) {
    const permutation = new Permutation(
      this.workspace,
      indices,
      this.length,
      "Preparing splat order",
    );
    this.records = permutation.apply(
      this.records,
      16,
      pool,
      false,
      "Reordering splats",
    );
    for (let band = 0; band < this.maxSh; band++)
      this.sh[band] = permutation.apply(
        this.sh[band],
        SH_DIMS[band],
        pool,
        false,
        `Reordering SH${band + 1}`,
      );
    permutation.dispose();
    this.length = indices.length;
  }

  dispose() {
    for (const column of [
      this.records,
      ...this.sh,
      this.childStart,
      this.childCount,
      this.children,
      this.weight,
      this.blend,
    ])
      column.dispose();
  }
}

// Merges two splats, given their Similarities terms `ca` and `cb` and
// weights (area × opacity), into the record `out`; `w` and `v` are then their
// blend weights.
export class Merger {
  constructor() {
    this.cov = new Float64Array(6);
    this.matrix = new Float64Array(9);
    this.vectors = new Float64Array(9);
    this.rotation = new Float64Array(9);
    this.axes = new Uint8Array(3);
    this.w = 0;
    this.v = 0;
  }
  run(ca, cb, wa, wb, out) {
    const total = Math.max(wa + wb, 1e-30);
    const w = wa / total;
    const v = wb / total;
    this.w = w;
    this.v = v;
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
      out[d] = Math.fround(ca[d] * w + cb[d] * v);
      out[4 + d] = half(ca[3 + d] * w + cb[3 + d] * v);
    }
    const ax = ca[0] - out[0];
    const ay = ca[1] - out[1];
    const az = ca[2] - out[2];
    const bx = cb[0] - out[0];
    const by = cb[1] - out[1];
    const bz = cb[2] - out[2];
    const cov = this.cov;
    cov[0] = (ca[6] + ax * ax) * w + (cb[6] + bx * bx) * v;
    cov[1] = (ca[7] + ay * ay) * w + (cb[7] + by * by) * v;
    cov[2] = (ca[8] + az * az) * w + (cb[8] + bz * bz) * v;
    cov[3] = (ca[9] + ax * ay) * w + (cb[9] + bx * by) * v;
    cov[4] = (ca[10] + ax * az) * w + (cb[10] + bx * bz) * v;
    cov[5] = (ca[11] + ay * az) * w + (cb[11] + by * bz) * v;
    for (const value of cov)
      if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new Error("LOD covariance overflow");
    eigens(cov, this.matrix, this.vectors, this.axes);
    const r = this.rotation;
    for (let col = 0; col < 3; col++) {
      const axis = this.axes[col];
      const norm = Math.hypot(
        this.vectors[axis],
        this.vectors[3 + axis],
        this.vectors[6 + axis],
      );
      for (let row = 0; row < 3; row++)
        r[col * 3 + row] = this.vectors[row * 3 + axis] / norm;
      out[7 + col] = Math.max(
        1e-30,
        Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, this.matrix[axis * 3 + axis])),
      );
    }
    if (
      r[0] * (r[4] * r[8] - r[5] * r[7]) -
        r[3] * (r[1] * r[8] - r[2] * r[7]) +
        r[6] * (r[1] * r[5] - r[2] * r[4]) <
      0
    ) {
      r[6] *= -1;
      r[7] *= -1;
      r[8] *= -1;
    }
    out[3] = half(
      Math.max(0.000001, Math.min(1000, total / area(out[7], out[8], out[9]))),
    );
    for (let d = 7; d <= 9; d++) out[d] = half(Math.log(out[d]));
    quaternion(r, out);
    for (let d = 10; d <= 13; d++) out[d] = half(out[d]);
    refresh(out);
    if (!Number.isFinite(out[14]) || !Number.isFinite(out[15]))
      throw new Error("LOD scale overflow");
  }
}

export class Similarities {
  constructor(splats) {
    this.splats = splats;
    this.record = new Float64Array(16);
    this.cov = new Float64Array(6);
    this.rotation = new Float64Array(9);
  }
  // The terms of splat `index`, then its weight as merge() sets it.
  get(index, out) {
    const record = this.splats.read(index, this.record);
    this.terms(record, out);
    out[13] = record[15] * record[3];
    return out;
  }
  // The terms of `record`: center, color, covariance and log determinant.
  terms(record, out) {
    covariance(record, this.cov, this.rotation);
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
      out[d] = record[d];
      out[3 + d] = record[4 + d];
    }
    for (let d = 0; d < 6; d++) out[6 + d] = Math.fround(this.cov[d]);
    out[12] = Math.fround(0.25 * Math.log(determinant(this.cov)));
    return out;
  }
}
```

### bin/rad/storage.js
```
import {
  closeSync,
  mkdirSync,
  mkdtempSync,
  openSync,
  readSync,
  rmSync,
  writeSync,
} from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import v8 from "node:v8";
import { runInNewContext } from "node:vm";
import { Progress } from "./progress.js";

export const PAGE_BYTES = 65536;
export const GIB = 1024 ** 3;
// Memory the budget keeps for growth between measurements.
const MARGIN = 64 * 1024 ** 2;
// Copied over new pages: fill(0) writes shared memory a byte at a time.
const ZERO = new Uint8Array(PAGE_BYTES);

// gc() on this thread and on worker threads started later: arenas that the
// cache releases, and garbage holding buffers, return their memory to the
// system only once collected.
v8.setFlagsFromString("--expose-gc");
globalThis.gc ??= runInNewContext("gc");
// Collects twice: a collection frees the memory of what the one before found.
export function collect() {
  globalThis.gc();
  globalThis.gc();
}

// All large arrays consist of 64 KiB pages. Neither one ArrayBuffer nor one
// WebAssembly memory has to hold the model, even with a 16+ GiB budget. Pages
// live in arenas of shared WebAssembly memory: worker threads can read the
// pages of shared arrays (see PagedArray.share() and SharedColumn), and an
// arena the cache releases returns its memory to the system once collected,
// which a SharedArrayBuffer does not on every platform. The cache takes what
// the budget leaves after the rest of the process, measured as it runs.
export class Workspace {
  constructor(budget, parent = tmpdir(), cancelled = null) {
    this.budget = budget;
    this.parent = parent;
    this.cancelled = cancelled;
    this.accesses = 0;
    this.directory = undefined;
    // Pages per arena, for at most about 256 arenas: each reserves 8 GiB of
    // address space.
    this.arenaPages = Math.max(256, Math.ceil(budget / 256 / PAGE_BYTES));
    this.arenaBytes = this.arenaPages * PAGE_BYTES;
    // The most memory the rest of the process has taken, and what it takes
    // with the threads about to start; see measure() and expect().
    this.outside = 0;
    this.floor = 0;
    this.allocations = 0;
    // Makes worker threads drop and collect their views of released arenas;
    // see Pool.collect().
    this.collector = undefined;
    this.used = 0;
    this.clock = 0;
    this.slots = [];
    this.free = [];
    this.arenas = [];
    // Each slot's page object and views, kept so that loading a page
    // allocates nothing: their garbage would read as memory of the process
    // and take room from the cache.
    this.reuse = [];
    // `version` is bumped when the arenas or a shared array's directory
    // change, `generation` when the arenas change.
    this.version = 0;
    this.generation = 0;
    this.files = new Map();
    this.nextFile = 0;
    this.readBytes = 0;
    this.writeBytes = 0;
    // An earlier conversion's arenas return once collected.
    this.settle();
  }

  check() {
    if (this.cancelled && Atomics.load(this.cancelled, 0))
      throw new Error("Conversion cancelled");
  }

  // Bytes all cached pages may take, at least one arena.
  get capacity() {
    return Math.max(
      this.arenaBytes,
      this.budget - MARGIN - Math.max(this.outside, this.floor),
    );
  }

  // Bytes the rest of the process may still grow by.
  get room() {
    return this.budget - MARGIN - this.arenaBytes - this.outside;
  }

  // Measures the memory of the rest of the process: all of it but the
  // arenas' pages that the cache has used.
  measure() {
    this.outside = Math.max(
      this.outside,
      process.memoryUsage.rss() - this.slots.length * PAGE_BYTES,
    );
  }

  // Measures the rest of the process anew once its garbage is collected, as
  // a phase starts.
  settle() {
    collect();
    this.outside = process.memoryUsage.rss() - this.slots.length * PAGE_BYTES;
  }

  // Makes room for `bytes` that the process is about to take besides the
  // cache.
  expect(bytes) {
    this.measure();
    this.floor = this.outside + bytes;
    if (this.budget - MARGIN - this.floor < this.arenaBytes)
      throw new Error("Memory budget too small; increase --memory-budget");
    this.shrink();
  }

  // Once the arenas' used pages take more than the capacity, releases the
  // arenas past it, evicting their pages, and collects them so that their
  // memory returns. The main thread allocates pages only between the jobs
  // of worker threads.
  shrink() {
    if (this.slots.length * PAGE_BYTES <= this.capacity) return;
    const slots = Math.floor(this.capacity / this.arenaBytes) * this.arenaPages;
    // Without a copy of the slots: a copy kept the released pages alive
    // through the collection below, and their memory returned only later.
    for (let slot = slots; slot < this.slots.length; slot++)
      if (this.slots[slot]) this.drop(this.slots[slot]);
    this.slots.length = slots;
    this.reuse.length = slots;
    this.free = this.free.filter((slot) => slot < slots);
    this.arenas.length = slots / this.arenaPages;
    this.version++;
    this.generation++;
    this.collector?.();
    collect();
  }

  file() {
    if (!this.directory) {
      mkdirSync(this.parent, { recursive: true });
      this.directory = mkdtempSync(join(this.parent, "gsl-build-rad-"));
      console.log(`Temporary files: ${this.directory}`);
    }
    const file = join(this.directory, `${this.nextFile++}.tmp`);
    const fd = openSync(file, "wx+");
    this.files.set(fd, file);
    return fd;
  }

  // Frees a file's disk space early. Anything left is removed with the
  // directory in dispose(), which reports a failure.
  close(fd) {
    const file = this.files.get(fd);
    this.files.delete(fd);
    try {
      closeSync(fd);
      rmSync(file);
    } catch {}
  }

  evict() {
    for (let step = 0; ; step++) {
      const slot = this.clock;
      this.clock = (this.clock + 1) % this.slots.length;
      const page = this.slots[slot];
      if (!page) continue;
      // Pinned pages go last, when the cache shrank below them: workers
      // leave pages that are not cached to the main thread.
      const pinned = page.array.pinned;
      if (
        step < this.slots.length * 2 &&
        (page.used || (page.index >= pinned[0] && page.index < pinned[1]))
      ) {
        page.used = false;
        continue;
      }
      this.drop(page);
      return;
    }
  }

  // Writes `page` to its array's file if it changed, and frees its slot.
  drop(page) {
    const array = page.array;
    if (page.dirty) {
      array.save(page.index, page.bytes);
      this.writeBytes += PAGE_BYTES;
    }
    this.unmap(page);
  }

  allocate(array, index) {
    if (++this.allocations % 64 === 0) {
      this.measure();
      this.shrink();
    }
    if (this.used + PAGE_BYTES > this.capacity && this.used) this.evict();
    let slot = this.free.pop();
    if (slot === undefined) {
      slot = this.slots.length;
      if (slot === this.arenas.length * this.arenaPages) {
        this.arenas.push(
          new WebAssembly.Memory({
            initial: this.arenaPages,
            maximum: this.arenaPages,
            shared: true,
          }).buffer,
        );
        this.version++;
        this.generation++;
      }
    }
    const arena = this.arenas[Math.floor(slot / this.arenaPages)];
    let reuse = this.reuse[slot];
    if (reuse?.arena !== arena) {
      const offset = (slot % this.arenaPages) * PAGE_BYTES;
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(arena, offset, PAGE_BYTES);
      reuse = {
        arena,
        offset,
        views: {},
        page: {
          array,
          index,
          bytes,
          values: bytes,
          words: undefined,
          dirty: false,
          used: true,
          slot,
        },
      };
      this.reuse[slot] = reuse;
    }
    const page = reuse.page;
    const bytes = page.bytes;
    if (array.restore(index, bytes)) this.readBytes += PAGE_BYTES;
    else bytes.set(ZERO);
    const { views, offset } = reuse;
    const name = array.Type.name;
    views[name] ??= new array.Type(arena, offset, array.items);
    if (array.wordView)
      views.Uint32Array ??= new Uint32Array(arena, offset, PAGE_BYTES / 4);
    page.array = array;
    page.index = index;
    page.values = views[name];
    page.words = array.wordView && views.Uint32Array;
    page.dirty = false;
    page.used = true;
    this.slots[slot] = page;
    this.used += PAGE_BYTES;
    // A store far past the end would turn `pages` into a slow dictionary.
    while (array.pages.length < index) array.pages.push(undefined);
    array.pages[index] = page;
    if (array.directory) array.map(index, slot);
    return page;
  }

  unmap(page) {
    page.array.pages[page.index] = undefined;
    if (page.array.directory) page.array.directory[page.index] = -1;
    this.slots[page.slot] = undefined;
    this.free.push(page.slot);
    this.used -= PAGE_BYTES;
  }

  release(array) {
    for (const page of array.pages) if (page) this.unmap(page);
    array.pages.length = 0;
  }

  dispose() {
    const progress = this.directory
      ? new Progress("Cleaning temporary files", this.files.size + 1)
      : undefined;
    let closed = 0;
    for (const fd of this.files.keys()) {
      this.close(fd);
      progress?.update(++closed);
    }
    if (this.directory) removePath(this.directory, { recursive: true });
    this.directory = undefined;
    this.slots.length = 0;
    this.reuse.length = 0;
    this.free.length = 0;
    this.arenas.length = 0;
    progress?.finish();
    if (this.readBytes || this.writeBytes) {
      console.log(
        `Temporary array I/O: ${(this.readBytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MiB read, ${(this.writeBytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MiB written`,
      );
    }
  }
}

export class PagedArray {
  constructor(workspace, Type, length = 0) {
    this.workspace = workspace;
    this.Type = Type;
    this.length = length;
    this.items = PAGE_BYTES / Type.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT;
    this.mask = this.items - 1;
    // Exact for the power of two, and faster than dividing.
    this.inverse = 1 / this.items;
    this.pages = [];
    // Pages not cached live in files: block b in stripe b % stripes, at
    // block b / stripes, so that threads reading pages at once share files
    // less; see share().
    this.stripes = 1;
    this.fds = [];
    this.sizes = [];
    // Also view each page as 32-bit words; see at().
    this.wordView = false;
    this.directory = undefined;
    // The blocks whose pages stay cached, for workers to write.
    this.pinned = [0, 0];
  }

  // Keeps a shared block -> slot directory (-1 when not cached), so workers
  // can read this array's cached pages through a SharedColumn.
  // With `stripes`, before any page is written, its pages are spread over
  // that many files.
  share(stripes = 1) {
    if (this.directory) return this;
    this.stripes = stripes;
    this.directory = new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(64 * 4)).fill(-1);
    this.workspace.version++;
    for (const page of this.pages) if (page) this.map(page.index, page.slot);
    return this;
  }
  // The files of the pages that are not cached, created if there are none.
  files() {
    for (let stripe = 0; stripe < this.stripes; stripe++)
      this.fds[stripe] ??= this.workspace.file();
    return this.fds;
  }
  // Writes the page of block `block`. Writing past the end of a file
  // extends it and fills the gap with zeros.
  save(block, bytes) {
    const stripe = block % this.stripes;
    const position = Math.floor(block / this.stripes) * PAGE_BYTES;
    this.fds[stripe] ??= this.workspace.file();
    writeAll(this.fds[stripe], bytes, position);
    this.sizes[stripe] = Math.max(
      this.sizes[stripe] ?? 0,
      position + PAGE_BYTES,
    );
  }
  // Reads the page of block `block` into `bytes` if a file holds it.
  restore(block, bytes) {
    const stripe = block % this.stripes;
    const position = Math.floor(block / this.stripes) * PAGE_BYTES;
    if (position >= (this.sizes[stripe] ?? 0)) return false;
    readAll(this.fds[stripe], bytes, position);
    return true;
  }
  map(block, slot) {
    if (block >= this.directory.length) {
      const old = this.directory;
      const size = Math.max(block + 1, old.length * 2);
      this.directory = new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(size * 4)).fill(-1);
      this.directory.set(old);
      this.workspace.version++;
    }
    this.directory[block] = slot;
  }

  page(index, write = false) {
    return this.at(index, write).values;
  }
  // The position of `index` in its page, after page() or at().
  offset(index) {
    return index & this.mask;
  }
  // The page of `index`: `values`, and `words` if wordView is set.
  at(index, write = false) {
    // Poll in-memory loops too, without an atomic read on every access.
    if ((++this.workspace.accesses & 4095) === 0) this.workspace.check();
    const block = Math.floor(index * this.inverse);
    const page = this.pages[block] ?? this.workspace.allocate(this, block);
    page.used = true;
    if (write) page.dirty = true;
    return page;
  }

  get(index) {
    return this.page(index)[index & this.mask];
  }
  set(index, value) {
    this.page(index, true)[index & this.mask] = value;
  }
  push(value) {
    this.set(this.length++, value);
  }

  // Loads the pages of items [from, to), for worker threads to use.
  load(from, to, write = false) {
    for (let index = from; index < to; index += this.items)
      this.at(index, write);
    this.at(to - 1, write);
  }

  // Reads `count` items from `base` into `output` from `at`. set() copies
  // long runs out of shared memory many times faster than a loop.
  read(base, output, count = output.length, at = 0) {
    let offset = 0;
    while (offset < count) {
      const index = base + offset;
      const page = this.page(index);
      const within = index & this.mask;
      const size = Math.min(count - offset, this.items - within);
      if (size > 64)
        output.set(page.subarray(within, within + size), at + offset);
      else
        for (let i = 0; i < size; i++)
          output[at + offset + i] = page[within + i];
      offset += size;
    }
    return output;
  }

  write(base, values, count = values.length) {
    let offset = 0;
    while (offset < count) {
      const index = base + offset;
      const page = this.page(index, true);
      const within = index & this.mask;
      const size = Math.min(count - offset, this.items - within);
      if (size > 64) page.set(values.subarray(offset, offset + size), within);
      else for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) page[within + i] = values[offset + i];
      offset += size;
    }
    this.length = Math.max(this.length, base + count);
  }

  dispose() {
    this.workspace.release(this);
    for (const fd of this.fds) if (fd !== undefined) this.workspace.close(fd);
    this.fds = [];
    this.sizes = [];
    this.length = 0;
  }
}

// A page of `fill` words for each type, made once per thread: columns are
// made anew whenever shared arrays change.
const EMPTY = new Map();
function empty(Type, fill) {
  const key = `${Type.name} ${fill}`;
  let page = EMPTY.get(key);
  if (!page) {
    const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(PAGE_BYTES);
    page = {
      values: new Type(buffer),
      words: new Uint32Array(buffer).fill(fill),
    };
    EMPTY.set(key, page);
  }
  return page;
}

// Bytes that a thread reads at a time of a page that is not cached, and how
// many such parts it keeps for each column.
const PART_BYTES = 16384;
const PARTS = 64;

// The parts of pages that a thread read from the file of a column of `Type`.
// The main thread changes no page while workers run a job; reset() forgets
// the parts read for the next.
export class Parts {
  constructor(Type) {
    const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(PARTS * PART_BYTES);
    this.views = { values: new Type(buffer), words: new Uint32Array(buffer) };
    this.bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
    this.items = PART_BYTES / Type.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT;
    // Part number -> position, and the part at each position.
    this.positions = new Map();
    this.numbers = new Float64Array(PARTS).fill(-1);
    this.next = 0;
    // Bytes read from files since taken; see Pool.run().
    this.bytesRead = 0;
  }
  reset() {
    if (!this.positions.size) return;
    this.positions.clear();
    this.numbers.fill(-1);
  }
  // The position of part `number` of `column`, read if needed.
  get(column, number) {
    let position = this.positions.get(number);
    if (position !== undefined) return position;
    // Replaces the oldest part; callers use a part before the next at().
    position = this.next;
    this.next = (position + 1) % PARTS;
    if (this.numbers[position] >= 0)
      this.positions.delete(this.numbers[position]);
    this.numbers[position] = number;
    this.positions.set(number, position);
    const bytes = this.bytes.subarray(
      position * PART_BYTES,
      (position + 1) * PART_BYTES,
    );
    const at = column.locate(number * PART_BYTES);
    let done = 0;
    while (done < PART_BYTES) {
      const count = readSync(
        column.fd,
        bytes,
        done,
        PART_BYTES - done,
        at + done,
      );
      if (!count) break;
      done += count;
    }
    this.bytesRead += done;
    // Past the end of the file, pages are zeros.
    if (done < PART_BYTES) bytes.fill(0, done);
    return position;
  }
}

// A thread's views of the arenas by type, made once for each generation of
// arenas: columns are made anew whenever shared arrays change.
export class ArenaViews {
  constructor() {
    this.generation = -1;
    this.arenas = [];
    this.types = new Map();
  }
  use(arenas, generation) {
    if (generation === this.generation) return;
    this.generation = generation;
    this.arenas = arenas;
    this.types.clear();
  }
  get(Type) {
    let views = this.types.get(Type);
    if (!views) {
      views = this.arenas.map((arena) => ({
        values: new Type(arena),
        words: new Uint32Array(arena),
      }));
      this.types.set(Type, views);
    }
    return views;
  }
}

// A worker's read-only view of a shared PagedArray. Pages are views of whole
// arenas, so offset() places an index within the last page found. A page that
// is not cached reads as `fill` words and sets `missed`, unless the column
// has the array's file `fd` and Parts: then the part around the index is
// read from the file, where the page is while not cached.
export class SharedColumn {
  constructor(
    views,
    directory,
    Type,
    fill = 0,
    fds = undefined,
    parts = undefined,
  ) {
    this.directory = directory;
    this.arenas = views.get(Type);
    this.arenaPages = this.arenas.length
      ? this.arenas[0].values.byteLength / PAGE_BYTES
      : 1;
    this.items = PAGE_BYTES / Type.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT;
    this.mask = this.items - 1;
    // Exact for the power of two, and faster than dividing.
    this.inverse = 1 / this.items;
    this.empty = empty(Type, fill);
    this.base = 0;
    // Whether a page was not cached, and the first such block.
    this.missed = false;
    this.block = 0;
    this.fds = fds;
    this.fd = -1;
    this.parts = parts;
    parts?.reset();
  }
  // The position of byte `offset` of the array in its file, which it sets
  // as `fd`.
  locate(offset) {
    const block = Math.floor(offset / PAGE_BYTES);
    const stripes = this.fds.length;
    this.fd = this.fds[block % stripes];
    return (
      Math.floor(block / stripes) * PAGE_BYTES + offset - block * PAGE_BYTES
    );
  }
  at(index) {
    const block = Math.floor(index * this.inverse);
    const slot = block < this.directory.length ? this.directory[block] : -1;
    if (slot < 0) {
      if (this.fds) return this.part(index);
      if (!this.missed) this.block = block;
      this.missed = true;
      this.base = 0;
      return this.empty;
    }
    this.base = (slot % this.arenaPages) * this.items;
    return this.arenas[Math.floor(slot / this.arenaPages)];
  }
  part(index) {
    const parts = this.parts;
    const number = Math.floor(index / parts.items);
    const position = parts.get(this, number);
    this.base = (position - (number % (PAGE_BYTES / PART_BYTES))) * parts.items;
    return parts.views;
  }
  offset(index) {
    return this.base + (index & this.mask);
  }
  page(index) {
    return this.at(index).values;
  }
  get(index) {
    return this.page(index)[this.offset(index)];
  }
}

// Gathers columns into the order of `indices`: row indices[i] of a column with
// `rows` rows becomes row i. Each output window, 7/8 of the cache, is
// filled while the column is read in order, so a column larger than the cache
// costs a few sequential passes instead of a page load per row.
export class Permutation {
  constructor(workspace, indices, rows, label) {
    this.workspace = workspace;
    this.length = indices.length;
    this.rows = rows;
    this.block = new Uint32Array(16384);
    // Source row -> target row + 1; 0 marks a row that is dropped.
    this.targets = new IndexArray(workspace);
    const progress = label && new Progress(label, indices.length);
    for (let base = 0; base < indices.length; base += this.block.length) {
      const count = Math.min(this.block.length, indices.length - base);
      indices.read(base, this.block, count);
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++)
        this.targets.set(this.block[i], base + i + 1);
      progress?.update(base + count);
    }
    progress?.finish();
  }

  // Returns `source` gathered into a new column, and disposes `source`. The
  // output window's pages stay cached while workers copy blocks of source
  // rows into it; rows across pages are left to the main thread. The output
  // spreads over as many files as `source`.
  // With `words`, rows are copied as 32-bit words, which keeps any bits of
  // floats, and the output has word views; see PagedArray.at().
  apply(source, stride, pool, words = false, label = undefined) {
    const output = new PagedArray(
      this.workspace,
      source.Type,
      this.length * stride,
    );
    output.wordView = words;
    output.share(source.stripes);
    source.share();
    const record = words ? new Uint32Array(stride) : new source.Type(stride);
    const { nodes: targets, later } = pool;
    const block = later.length;
    // The window's pages are pinned; the rest of the cache holds the source
    // rows a block at a time.
    const window = Math.floor(
      (this.workspace.capacity * 7) /
        8 /
        (stride * source.Type.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT),
    );
    const progress =
      label && new Progress(label, Math.ceil(this.length / window) * this.rows);
    for (let start = 0; start < this.length; start += window) {
      const end = Math.min(this.length, start + window);
      output.pinned = [
        Math.floor((start * stride) / output.items),
        Math.floor((end * stride - 1) / output.items) + 1,
      ];
      output.load(start * stride, end * stride, true);
      for (let base = 0; base < this.rows; base += block) {
        const count = Math.min(block, this.rows - base);
        this.targets.read(base, targets, count);
        source.load(base * stride, (base + count) * stride);
        pool.copy(source, output, stride, count, base, start, end, words);
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          if (!later[i]) continue;
          const from = (base + i) * stride;
          const to = (targets[i] - 1) * stride;
          if (!words) {
            source.read(from, record);
            output.write(to, record);
            continue;
          }
          // Rows of words lie within a page.
          const values = source.at(from).words;
          for (let d = 0; d < stride; d++)
            record[d] = values[(from & source.mask) + d];
          const out = output.at(to, true).words;
          for (let d = 0; d < stride; d++)
            out[(to & output.mask) + d] = record[d];
        }
        progress?.update(Math.floor(start / window) * this.rows + base + count);
      }
    }
    output.pinned = [0, 0];
    source.dispose();
    progress?.finish();
    return output;
  }

  dispose() {
    this.targets.dispose();
  }
}

// Keep hot integer lookups separate from the mixed attribute types so V8 can
// specialize their TypedArray access during heap and spatial-grid traversal.
export class IndexArray extends PagedArray {
  constructor(workspace) {
    super(workspace, Uint32Array);
  }
  get(index) {
    return this.page(index)[index & this.mask];
  }
  set(index, value) {
    this.page(index, true)[index & this.mask] = value;
  }
}

// Cleanup never throws, so it cannot replace a conversion error. A failure is
// reported with the path, so the leftover can be removed by hand.
export function removePath(file, options) {
  try {
    rmSync(file, options);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code !== "ENOENT")
      console.warn(`Could not remove ${file} (${error.code ?? error.message})`);
  }
}

export function readAll(fd, bytes, position) {
  let offset = 0;
  while (offset < bytes.byteLength) {
    const count = readSync(
      fd,
      bytes,
      offset,
      bytes.byteLength - offset,
      position + offset,
    );
    if (!count) throw new Error("Truncated input or temporary file");
    offset += count;
  }
  return bytes;
}

export function writeAll(fd, bytes, position) {
  let offset = 0;
  while (offset < bytes.byteLength) {
    const count = writeSync(
      fd,
      bytes,
      offset,
      bytes.byteLength - offset,
      position + offset,
    );
    if (!count) throw new Error("Unable to write output or temporary file");
    offset += count;
  }
}

const CAMERA_CENTER_MODE_DISTANCE_SQ = 3000000 ** 2;

const _scaledOrigin = new Vector3();
const _scaledDirection = new Vector3();
const _scaledPoint = new Vector3();
const _scaledRay = new Ray();
const _zero = new Vector3();

/**
 * Axis-aligned ellipsoid centered at the origin.
 */
class Ellipsoid {
  constructor(x = 1, y = 1, z = 1) {
    this.radius = new Vector3(x, y, z);
  }

  intersectRay(ray, target) {
    const { x, y, z } = this.radius;
    if (x <= 0 || y <= 0 || z <= 0) {
      return null;
    }

    _scaledOrigin.set(ray.origin.x / x, ray.origin.y / y, ray.origin.z / z);
    _scaledDirection.set(
      ray.direction.x / x,
      ray.direction.y / y,
      ray.direction.z / z,
    );

    // Intersect the ray with a unit sphere in ellipsoid-scaled space. Keep
    // the original ray parameter so the resulting point is in world space.
    const a = _scaledDirection.lengthSq();
    if (a === 0) {
      return null;
    }
    const halfB = _scaledOrigin.dot(_scaledDirection);
    const c = _scaledOrigin.lengthSq() - 1;
    const discriminant = halfB * halfB - a * c;
    if (discriminant < 0) {
      return null;
    }

    const sqrtDiscriminant = Math.sqrt(discriminant);
    const near = (-halfB - sqrtDiscriminant) / a;
    const far = (-halfB + sqrtDiscriminant) / a;
    const distance = near >= 0 ? near : far >= 0 ? far : null;
    return distance === null ? null : ray.at(distance, target);
  }

  getPositionToNormal(position, target) {
    const { x, y, z } = this.radius;
    target.set(
      x > 0 ? position.x / (x * x) : 0,
      y > 0 ? position.y / (y * y) : 0,
      z > 0 ? position.z / (z * z) : 0,
    );
    return target.normalize();
  }

  closestPointToRayEstimate(ray, target) {
    const intersection = this.intersectRay(ray, target);
    if (intersection) {
      return intersection;
    }

    const { x, y, z } = this.radius;
    if (x <= 0 || y <= 0 || z <= 0) {
      return target.set(0, 0, 0);
    }

    _scaledRay.origin.set(ray.origin.x / x, ray.origin.y / y, ray.origin.z / z);
    _scaledRay.direction
      .set(ray.direction.x / x, ray.direction.y / y, ray.direction.z / z)
      .normalize();
    _scaledRay.closestPointToPoint(_zero, _scaledPoint);

    // A ray through the center has no unique radial estimate. Choose the
    // surface point facing its origin, or the point opposite its direction
    // when the ray also starts at the center.
    if (_scaledPoint.lengthSq() === 0) {
      _scaledPoint.copy(_scaledRay.origin);
      if (_scaledPoint.lengthSq() === 0) {
        _scaledPoint.copy(_scaledRay.direction).negate();
      }
    }

    _scaledPoint.normalize();
    return target.set(
      _scaledPoint.x * x,
      _scaledPoint.y * y,
      _scaledPoint.z * z,
    );
  }
}

class PointerTracker {
  buttons;
  pointerType;
  pointerOrder;
  previousPositions;
  pointerPositions;
  startPositions;
  hoverPosition;
  hoverSet;
  constructor() {
    this.buttons = 0;
    this.pointerType = null;
    this.pointerOrder = [];
    this.previousPositions = {};
    this.pointerPositions = {};
    this.startPositions = {};
    this.hoverPosition = new Vector2();
    this.hoverSet = false;
  }
  reset() {
    this.buttons = 0;
    this.pointerType = null;
    this.pointerOrder = [];
    this.previousPositions = {};
    this.pointerPositions = {};
    this.startPositions = {};
    this.hoverPosition = new Vector2();
    this.hoverSet = false;
  }
  // The pointers can be set multiple times per frame so track whether the pointer has
  // been set this frame or not so we don't overwrite the previous position and lose information
  // about pointer movement
  updateFrame() {
    const { previousPositions, pointerPositions } = this;
    for (const id in pointerPositions) {
      previousPositions[id].copy(pointerPositions[id]);
    }
  }
  setHoverEvent(e) {
    if (e.pointerType === "mouse" || e.type === "wheel") {
      this.getClientPointer(e, this.hoverPosition);
      this.hoverSet = true;
    }
  }
  getLatestPoint(target) {
    if (this.pointerType !== null) {
      this.getCenterPoint(target);
      return target;
    }
    if (this.hoverSet) {
      target.copy(this.hoverPosition);
      return target;
    }
    return null;
  }
  // Keep pointer positions in viewport coordinates. mouseToCoords converts
  // them to element-local NDC exactly once when a ray is needed.
  getClientPointer(e, target) {
    target.set(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  }
  addPointer(e) {
    const id = e.pointerId;
    const position = new Vector2();
    this.getClientPointer(e, position);
    if (this.pointerOrder.indexOf(id) === -1) {
      this.pointerOrder.push(id);
    }
    this.pointerPositions[id] = position;
    this.previousPositions[id] = position.clone();
    this.startPositions[id] = position.clone();
    if (this.getPointerCount() === 1) {
      this.pointerType = e.pointerType;
      this.buttons = e.buttons;
    }
  }
  updatePointer(e) {
    const id = e.pointerId;
    if (!(id in this.pointerPositions)) {
      return false;
    }
    this.getClientPointer(e, this.pointerPositions[id]);
    return true;
  }
  deletePointer(e) {
    const id = e.pointerId;
    const pointerOrder = this.pointerOrder;
    const pointerIndex = pointerOrder.indexOf(id);
    if (pointerIndex === -1) {
      return false;
    }
    pointerOrder.splice(pointerIndex, 1);
    delete this.pointerPositions[id];
    delete this.previousPositions[id];
    delete this.startPositions[id];
    if (this.getPointerCount() === 0) {
      this.buttons = 0;
      this.pointerType = null;
    }
    return true;
  }
  getPointerCount() {
    return this.pointerOrder.length;
  }
  getCenterPoint(target, pointerPositions = this.pointerPositions) {
    const pointerOrder = this.pointerOrder;
    if (this.getPointerCount() === 1 || this.getPointerType() === "mouse") {
      const id = pointerOrder[0];
      target.copy(pointerPositions[id]);
      return target;
    }
    if (this.getPointerCount() === 2) {
      const id0 = this.pointerOrder[0];
      const id1 = this.pointerOrder[1];
      const p0 = pointerPositions[id0];
      const p1 = pointerPositions[id1];
      target.addVectors(p0, p1).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      return target;
    }
    if (this.getPointerCount() > 2) {
      target.set(0, 0);
      for (let i = 0; i < pointerOrder.length; i++) {
        const id = pointerOrder[i];
        target.add(pointerPositions[id]);
      }
      target.divideScalar(pointerOrder.length);
      return target;
    }
    return null;
  }
  getPreviousCenterPoint(target) {
    return this.getCenterPoint(target, this.previousPositions);
  }
  getStartCenterPoint(target) {
    return this.getCenterPoint(target, this.startPositions);
  }
  getMoveDistance() {
    this.getCenterPoint(_vec);
    this.getPreviousCenterPoint(_vec2);
    return _vec.sub(_vec2).length();
  }
  getTouchPointerDistance(pointerPositions = this.pointerPositions) {
    if (this.getPointerCount() <= 1 || this.getPointerType() === "mouse") {
      return 0;
    }
    const { pointerOrder } = this;
    const id0 = pointerOrder[0];
    const id1 = pointerOrder[1];
    const p0 = pointerPositions[id0];
    const p1 = pointerPositions[id1];
    return p0.distanceTo(p1);
  }
  getPreviousTouchPointerDistance() {
    return this.getTouchPointerDistance(this.previousPositions);
  }
  getStartTouchPointerDistance() {
    return this.getTouchPointerDistance(this.startPositions);
  }
  getPointerType() {
    return this.pointerType;
  }
  isPointerTouch() {
    return this.getPointerType() === "touch";
  }
  getPointerButtons() {
    return this.buttons;
  }
  isLeftClicked() {
    return Boolean(this.buttons & 1);
  }
  isRightClicked() {
    return Boolean(this.buttons & 2);
  }
  isMiddleClicked() {
    return Boolean(this.buttons & 4);
  }
}

class PivotPointMesh extends Mesh {
  constructor(renderer, size = 15, thickness = 3) {
    const material = renderer.isWebGPURenderer
      ? new PivotNodeMaterial(size, thickness)
      : new PivotMaterial(size, thickness);
    super(new PlaneGeometry(0, 0), material);
    // Three.js r186 preserves renderOrder with either depth mode.
    this.renderOrder = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  }

  set focus(value) {
    this.material.uniforms.opacity.value = value ? 1 : 0.5;
  }

  onBeforeRender(renderer) {
    renderer.getSize(this.material.uniforms.resolution.value);
  }

  updateMatrixWorld() {
    this.matrixWorld.makeTranslation(this.position);
  }

  dispose() {
    super.dispose();
    this.geometry.dispose();
    this.material.dispose();
  }
}

function makePivotUniforms(size, thickness) {
  const coreD = size + thickness;
  const planeD = coreD + 3 * thickness;
  const normThk = thickness / coreD;
  const ringR = (coreD - 0.4 * thickness - 4.0) / coreD;
  const hw = 0.4 * normThk;
  return {
    resolution: { value: new Vector2() },
    opacity: { value: 1 },
    planeD: { value: planeD },
    hw: { value: hw },
    ringR: { value: ringR },
    shadowW: { value: hw * 5.0 },
    uvScale: { value: planeD / coreD },
  };
}

class PivotMaterial extends ShaderMaterial {
  constructor(size, thickness) {
    const uniforms = makePivotUniforms(size, thickness);

    super({
      depthWrite: false,
      depthTest: false,
      transparent: true,

      uniforms,

      vertexShader: `
        uniform float planeD;
        uniform vec2 resolution;
        varying vec2 vUv;

        void main() {
          vUv = uv;
          float aspect = resolution.x / resolution.y;
          vec2 offset = uv * 2.0 - vec2(1.0);
          offset.y *= aspect;
          vec4 screenPoint = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
          screenPoint.xy += offset * planeD * screenPoint.w / resolution.x;
          gl_Position = screenPoint;
        }
      `,
      fragmentShader: `
        uniform float hw;
        uniform float ringR;
        uniform float shadowW;
        uniform float opacity;
        uniform float uvScale;
        varying vec2 vUv;

        void main() {
          vec2 uv = (vUv * 2.0 - 1.0) * uvScale;
          float len = length(uv);
          float fw = fwidth(len) * 0.5;
          float d = abs(len - ringR);

          float ring = 1.0 - smoothstep(hw - fw, hw + fw, d);

          float shadow = (1.0 - smoothstep(hw, shadowW, d)) * (1.0 - smoothstep(ringR - fw, ringR + fw, len)) * 0.5;

          float white = ring;
          float black = shadow * (1.0 - white);
          float alpha = (white + black) * opacity;
          if (alpha < 0.001) discard;
          vec4 rgba = vec4(vec3(white / max(alpha / opacity, 0.001)), alpha);
          gl_FragColor = rgba;
        }
      `,
    });
  }
}

class PivotNodeMaterial extends NodeMaterial {
  constructor(size, thickness) {
    super();
    const uniforms = makePivotUniforms(size, thickness);
    const bindings = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(uniforms).map(([name, entry]) => [
        name,
        uniform(entry.value).onObjectUpdate(() => entry.value),
      ]),
    );

    this.depthWrite = false;
    this.depthTest = false;
    this.transparent = true;
    this.uniforms = uniforms;

    this.vertexNode = Fn(() => {
      const pivotUv = varyingProperty("vec2", "pivotUv");
      pivotUv.assign(uv());
      const aspect = bindings.resolution.x.div(bindings.resolution.y);
      const offset = uv().mul(2).sub(vec2(1)).toVar();
      offset.y.mulAssign(aspect);
      const screenPoint = cameraProjectionMatrix
        .mul(modelViewMatrix)
        .mul(vec4(positionGeometry, 1))
        .toVar();
      screenPoint.xy.addAssign(
        offset
          .mul(bindings.planeD)
          .mul(screenPoint.w)
          .div(bindings.resolution.x),
      );
      return screenPoint;
    })();

    this.colorNode = Fn(() => {
      const pivotUv = varyingProperty("vec2", "pivotUv");
      const localUv = pivotUv.mul(2).sub(1).mul(bindings.uvScale);
      const length = localUv.length();
      const fw = length.fwidth().mul(0.5);
      const distance = length.sub(bindings.ringR).abs();
      const ring = smoothstep(
        bindings.hw.sub(fw),
        bindings.hw.add(fw),
        distance,
      ).oneMinus();
      const shadow = smoothstep(bindings.hw, bindings.shadowW, distance)
        .oneMinus()
        .mul(
          smoothstep(
            bindings.ringR.sub(fw),
            bindings.ringR.add(fw),
            length,
          ).oneMinus(),
        )
        .mul(0.5);
      const white = ring;
      const black = shadow.mul(white.oneMinus());
      const alpha = white.add(black).mul(bindings.opacity);
      alpha.lessThan(0.001).discard();
      const color = vec3(white.div(alpha.div(bindings.opacity).max(0.001)));
      return vec4(color, alpha);
    })();
  }
}

const _matrix = new Matrix4();
// custom version of set raycaster from camera that relies on the underlying matrices
// so the ray origin is position at the camera near clip.
function setRaycasterFromCamera(raycaster, coords, camera) {
  const ray = raycaster instanceof Ray ? raycaster : raycaster.ray;
  const { origin, direction } = ray;
  // With reversed depth the NDC z range is [1, 0] (near→1, far→0)
  // instead of the standard [-1, 1] (near→-1, far→1).
  const nearZ = camera.reversedDepth ? 1 : -1;
  const farZ = camera.reversedDepth ? 0 : 1;
  // get the origin and direction of the frustum ray
  origin.set(coords.x, coords.y, nearZ).unproject(camera);
  direction.set(coords.x, coords.y, farZ).unproject(camera).sub(origin);
  if (!raycaster.isRay) {
    // compute the far value based on the distance from point on the near
    // plane and point on the far plane. Then normalize the direction.
    raycaster.near = 0;
    raycaster.far = direction.length();
    raycaster.camera = camera;
  }
  // normalize the ray direction
  direction.normalize();
}
function mouseToCoords(clientX, clientY, element, target) {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  target.x = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
  target.y = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
}
function makeRotateAroundPoint(point, quat, target) {
  target.makeTranslation(-point.x, -point.y, -point.z);
  _matrix.makeRotationFromQuaternion(quat);
  target.premultiply(_matrix);
  _matrix.makeTranslation(point.x, point.y, point.z);
  target.premultiply(_matrix);
  return target;
}
